name: Skill Point
description: An item of power. Feed it to the Flame to gain its strength.

name: Health Potion
description: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.

name: Bandage
description:
A simple bandage.

This item provides healing if applied to a wound.

name: Greater Health Potion
description: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.

name: Wisp of Light
description: An imprisoned Wisp of Light. Opening the flask releases a glowing wisp that lights the darkness.

name: Mana Potion
description: Created with mana-potent ingredients, the Mana Potion restores a good amount of mana.

name: Greater Mana Potion
description: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.

name: Shroud Meteor Scroll
description: This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor. It calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

name: Cleaned Bandage
description:
A bandage combined with antiseptics.

This item provides improved healing if applied to a wound.

name: Prayer of the Flame Scroll
description: Offers a small prayer to the Flame, that increases your magic damage and the maximum time in the Shroud for a short duration.
lore:
A tiny flame, a tiny light
banishes the darkness and all its blight

name: Flask of the Fell
description:
The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.

Increases stamina by 20.

name: Mysterious Flask
description: A strange flask exuding a feeling of power.

name: Experience Scroll
description:
The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll.

Gain a small amount of experience upon absorption of the content.

name: Sacred Vukah Scroll
description: Offers a prayer to the ancient Vukah. If answered, the user will deal more damage against Scavengers and be fortified against their poison.
lore:
A tiny flame, a tiny light
banishes the darkness and all its blight

name: Explosive Powder Ball
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Fire Wisp Summon
description: The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.

name: Revitalizing Health Potion
description:
The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations.

Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.

name: Shroud Survival Flask
description:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 2 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
description:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 4 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

name: Black Powder Ball
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Powder Ball Net
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel I
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Ice Protection Lotion
description: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per character level.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel II
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel III
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Superior Mana Potion
description: A precisely formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

name: Greater Antidote
description:
An improved antidote that will cure poisoning upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the player from poisoning.

name: Improved Bandage
description:
A bandage that was made more absorbent by moss. The added silver dust and wound ointment will cure poison.

This item heals 70% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. 

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

name: Snowball
description: A lumpy ball of snow. It's harmless enough as long as you don't put any rocks inside!

name: Purple Rocket
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Blue Rocket
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Green Rocket
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Yellow Fountain
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Red Fountain
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Incendiary Ball
description:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Pocket Heater
description: After Ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.

name: Superior Health Potion
description:
It's a truly inspired concoction, and vastly superior to all other currently known Health Potions.

Instantly restores a supreme amount of health.

name: Antidote
description: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.

name: Blue Confetti Mortar
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Yellow Confetti Mortar
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Red Confetti Mortar
description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

name: Repair Kit
description: Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.

name: Fell Confusion Pheromones
description: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

name: Explosive Crawler
description:
A mindless, throwable drone made from critter carapaces. Once deployed, the crawler will seek the nearest enemy and combust.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic
description:
Removes the Fell Curse upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

name: Hemotoxin Antidote
description:
Removes the Hemotoxin debuff upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.

name: Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Greater Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Revitalizing Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Superior Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a small amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Greater Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Superior Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Ultimate Mana Potion
description: A excellently formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

name: Ultimate Health Potion
description:
Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.

This one instantly restores a massive amount of health.

name: Ultimate Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Ultimate Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Diver’s Endurance Flask
description: A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke. Reduces stamina drain while sprint swimming or sprint diving.

name: Drak Soulward Flask
description: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them. Enables you to read Drakian writings and grants you additional damage against them.

name: Water Balloon
description: A plump leather container that's been filled with water. Throw it to make others Wet and Soaked! Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
description:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 4 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

name: Ancient Mana Potion
description: A flawlessly formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

name: Ancient Health Potion
description: A flawlessly formulated health potion that instantly restores a massive amount of health upon use.

name: Ancient Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Ancient Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Puke Potion
description: Empties your stomach immediately and clears all active food buffs. Sadly not effective against food poisoning.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel IV
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel V
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Ultimate Bandage
description:
A highly effective bandage with thyme extract.

This item heals 80% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound and clears any poison effect.

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

name: Wood Planks
description: Planks created by cutting Wood Logs into shape. Very useful for building.

name: Wood Logs
description: The byproducts of felling a tree. Just be careful that it doesn't fall on your head!

name: Torn Cloth
description: Torn and tattered remains of cloth that were left behind and now serve the Scavengers as clothing.

name: String
description: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.

name: Resin
description: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
acquisition_hint: Trees, mainly stumps and red-leaved trees

name: Plant Fiber
description: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.

name: Nails
description: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.

name: Iron Bars
description: A glistening silver metal that has a wide range of applications.

name: Metal Scraps
description: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.

name: Leather
description: A versatile and durable material that is smooth to the touch. It also has the advantage of being waterproof.

name: Iron Ore
description: The natural resource needed to create Iron Bars, an important material for every adventurer on the way to the top.

name: Enshrouded Oil
description: Its uses are unknown even to the creator itself, but it definitely didn't help the skin of the Fell!

name: Shroud Spores
description: A strange kind of energy. It appears unstable for now, but perhaps it can be refined.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, Springlands Shroud and Revelwood Shroud

name: Shroud Core
description: A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.

name: Lump of Clay
description: A malleable material that is especially useful for construction purposes.

name: Amber
description: Created through years of petrification, it has become a beautiful material used for production.

name: Kindlewastes Flower
description: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.

name: Copper Ore
description: A common ore needed to create Copper Bars.

name: Copper Bars
description: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.

name: Twigs
description: A twig, as insignificant as it might seem, has a lot of potential. Everything starts somewhere...

name: Wheat Grains
description: Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.

name: Straw
description: A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.

name: Flour
description: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.

name: Obsidian
description: Volcanic, pitch-black glass formed centuries ago. It leaves sharp edges when fractured, making it interesting for smithing and crafting.

name: Animal Fur
description: Warm and comfortable during yearfall. A versatile resource that is very common and can be used for many things.

name: Feather
description: A feather of a bird or creature of some kind. Weighing next to nothing, it has to be useful for something.

name: Spark
description: A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.
acquisition_hint: Found in Flame Shrines and Sanctums

name: Wax
description: A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.

name: Tar
description: Not very pretty, but useful when it comes to creating protection from the elements.

name: Wood Acid
description: This byproduct of the Charcoal Kiln has many useful properties, which can be used in medicine and alchemy.

name: Flintstone
description: A soft small rock that became famous for its ability to release sparks. It has been associated with the Flame ever since.

name: Critter Parts
description: Remains of the pests that dwell below the Shroud. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, Springlands Shroud and Revelwood Shroud

name: Salt
description: Crystalline powder, which can be found in enshrouded valleys. The taste of food can be improved drastically when sprinkled with salt.

name: Shroud Wood
description: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.

name: Mycelium
description: Mycelium of mushrooms that have been absorbing the magical properties of the Shroud. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?

name: Charcoal
description: Created in a kiln under high temperatures. Burned wood mixed with oxygen creates a flammable material, highly convenient and needed to dive into the world of craftsmanship.

name: Metal Sheets
description: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.

name: Dried Fur
description: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.

name: Bonemeal
description: Useful for alchemical and magical purposes.

name: Chamomile
description: A wondrous flower known for many potential applications, but used mostly for healing purposes.

name: Indigo Plant
description: A plant known for its flowers and the deep blue organic pigment that can be won by processing it.

name: Flax
description: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.

name: Mint Mushroom Meat
description: Mint Mushroom Meat that can be used to dye all sorts of fabrics green. The name suggests a minty fresh taste, but consumption is strongly discouraged.

name: Poison Sack
description: It's considered to be one of the most dangerous materials in the world! Touching it directly is usually not a good idea.

name: Shroud Sack
description: An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Fossilized Bone
description: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availibility and high magical capacity.

name: Ammonia Gland
description: This gland contains a concentrated substance which can be used to tan furs. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Mushroom Crabs, Nomad Highlands Shroud and Kindlewastes Shroud

name: Bones
description: Possessing magical properties, bones of the dead are often used in alchemy.

name: Bug Dust
description: A protein rich ingredient created from crushed critter shells.

name: Goo
description: A sticky paste used to bind chemical substances.

name: Glow Dust
description: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.

name: Linen
description: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax. The first step of cloth creation.

name: Fired Bricks
description: Shiny red bricks that are crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.

name: Bronze Bars
description: A beautiful material known for its warm and bright color. Artisans around the world have turned towards it for centuries, due to its workable characteristics.

name: Fossilized Bone Dust
description: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.

name: Alchemical Base
description: A clear liquid with a sharp smell. Used to enhance alchemical reactions.

name: Tin Bars
description: A metal used to create bronze. It can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Tin Ore
description: An ore which contains traces of tin. Needed to create Tin Bars.

name: Sulfur
description: An important material and basic chemical ingredient found in nature. It can be used to make bright orange and red dyes. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Coal Powder
description: Ground up coals, creating a highly flammable powder.

name: Glass
description: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!

name: Aloe
description: This desert plant contains a slimy liquid, which is know to have medical applications. Used in alchemy.

name: Lapislazuli
description: A rare gem famous for its magical properties as a catalyst. It's great for channeling and shielding!

name: Glass Shards
description: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.

name: Paper
description: A traditional but mighty tool of communication. Used for the preservation of knowledge.

name: Shroud Liquid
description:
The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths of the Springlands biome.

The brown fluid emits a violet vapor and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.

name: Rooibos
description: An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.

name: Saffron
description: A rare herbal plant that can be found in hot climates. It's used to create vibrant golden-yellow dyes.

name: Spice
description: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!

name: Fabric
description: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.

name: Yellow Fabric
description: Yellow dyed fabric used for clothing.

name: Green Fabric
description: The color of life — a wonderful color for clothes.

name: Blue Fabric
description: Blue dyed fabric used for clothing.

name: Red Fabric
description: Red - the color of the Flame fitting for a Flameborn!

name: Padding
description: A basic ingredient for all advanced armor. The padding added below the hard shell can create comfort and soften impacts. A Loom is needed to craft both padding and advanced armor.

name: Palm Wood Logs
description: Logs of a freshly cut palm, ready to be processed to an item of choosing.

name: Scales
description: Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.

name: Nitrate
description: An alchemical acid used to create explosive substances.

name: Black Powder
description: A dangerous alchemical substance used to produce explosives. Better watch out!

name: Fell Monstrosity Head
description: Despair, hatred, loneliness... it grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.

name: Fell Wispwyvern Head
description: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.

name: Vukah Brawler Head
description: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!

name: Fell Sicklescythe Head
description: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.

name: Scavenger Matron Helmet
description: She is less fearsome without her helmet. The acidic scent lingers, however.

name: Fell Thunderbrute Head
description: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.

name: Fur Patch
description: A small shred of animal fur.

name: Old Books
description: A stack of old parchments, worn and torn by the ravages of time. A wise man could salvage something from the remnants.

name: Hardwood
description: This especially tough wood could cause much damage if it hits your head while you fell trees.

name: Ectoplasm Fragment
description: A small amount of frozen or crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy.

name: Ectoplasm Shard
description: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.

name: Ectoplasm Crystal
description: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.

name: Giant Bones
description: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.
acquisition_hint: Hollow Cyclops, First: Revelwood Hollow Halls

name: Hollow Cyclops Head
description: Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.

name: Ectoplasm
description: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.

name: Greater Ectoplasm
description: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered and is technically sterile.

name: Excellent Ectoplasm
description: A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".

name: Red Marble Fragment
description: This simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.

name: Ectoplasm Gem
description: Crystallized from evaporated ectoplasm and bonemeal. Used to craft bone keys or decorative furniture.

name: Purified Slime
description: A green glowing material that's been cleansed to rid it of its toxic characteristics.

name: Toxic Slime
description: Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!

name: White Glowing Substance
description: This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!

name: Reptile Hide
description: The tough and scaly skin of a reptile.

name: Reptile Leather
description: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.

name: Silver Dust
description: Fine, shimmery silver powder. Don't drop it, or you'll find specs of silver in your floorboards for weeks to come.

name: Obsidian Dust
description: Finely ground obsidian powder. It can more easily be alchemized in this form.

name: Wound Ointment
description: Useful for flesh wounds.

name: Mauveine
description: A violet dye, often used in the creation of opulent garments for royals.

name: Hardened Leather
description: This patch of leather has been made more sturdy and enduring.

name: Warm Padding
description: A warmer and better-insulated padding kit. When used to create armor, it will protect you from the bitter cold.

name: Violet Fabric
description: A luscious, dyed fabric, usually reserved for creating the finest garments.

name: Silver Ore
description: Silver is a precious metal often found in combination with other minerals. This raw silver ore will need to be processed to become useful.

name: Silver Bars
description: Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.

name: Amethyst
description: A beautiful mineral, usually found beneath the Shroud. Its color can range from a deep and saturated royal purple to a light, lavender hue.

name: Coal
description: A hard lump of coal. It makes for great fuel!

name: Steel Bars
description: As an alloy of both iron and carbon, steel possesses better resistance and therefore provides more protection when used in armor.

name: Wolfsbane
description: This plant is notable due to its stunning electrifying colorway, its delicate petals, and its deadly poison.

name: Wool
description: Refined wool. It can be used for weaving garments and warm padding.

name: Raw Wool
description: Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.

name: Conifer Logs
description: The raw and untreated wood of conifer trees. They fill the air with a fresh smell of pine needles and sweet resin.

name: Cyclops Head
description:
The severed head of a fearsome cyclops. It looks down on you with disdain.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Fell Cyclops Head
description:
The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Fell Dragon Youngling Head
description:
Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. The shimmering scales are ice-cold.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Flammable Goo
description: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!

name: Antiseptic
description: A medical solution to prevent wound infections. Among other things, it can be used to disinfect bandages.

name: Archaic Essence I
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Archaic Essence II
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Archaic Essence III
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Archaic Essence IV
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Archaic Essence V
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Runes
description: Runes are mystical artifacts that attract and store magical energy from the environment. Craftspeople and their assistants can use runes to enhance your weapons, shields, armors and rings, which provides powerful bonuses and effects. Salvage weapons, shields, armors and rings to recover runes, allowing you to reuse them and customize your arsenal.

name: Legendary Runes
description: Legendary runes are infused with an immense amount of magical energy. These rare and powerful artifacts are required to enhance legendary weapons, shields, armors and rings, unlocking their full potential. Craftspeople and their assistants can use Runes to imbue said equipment with powerful bonuses and effects. Once used, legendary runes become an integral part of the imbued equipment and cannot be recovered. Choose wisely, for the power they bestow is both extraordinary and irreplaceable.

name: Shroud Particles
description: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, Nomad Highlands Shroud, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud

name: Shroud Nexus
description: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
acquisition_hint: Alchemist or Fell Monstrosity and Fell Sicklescythe

name: Shroud Mushroom
description:
A mushroom that is commonly found beneath the Shroud. 
It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

name: Brittle Shroud Flakes
description:
If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

name: Enshrouded Ice
description:
Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cold to the touch.

Commonly found in the Shroud of the Albaneve Summits biome.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

name: Acidic Mycelium
description: Acidic Mycelium mined in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Shroud Vapor
description: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.

name: Critter Glands
description: A pair of slippery Glands. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud

name: Critter Carapace
description: A carapace that protects the soft critter's flesh underneath. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, Albaneve Summits Shroud and Veilwater Basin Shroud

name: Chitin Powder
description: Fine powder made from grinding critter carapaces.

name: Spider Gland
description:
A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams.

Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.

name: Corrupted Boar Tusk
description: A jagged tusk that's been tainted by the Shroud. Pulsing with faint traces of toxic energy. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Shroud Gelatin
description: A translucent, gelatinous substance. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Shroud Depthdweller, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

name: Brittle Shroud Petals
description: Delicate petals tainted by the Shroud. Their surface is coated in a faint, toxic residue. Though fragile on their own, they are surprisingly resilient when woven into armor. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Enshrouded Vulture Talon
description: A massive, razor-sharp talon. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Draconian Vulture, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud

name: Corrosive Blood
description: A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

name: Aerated Banshee Gel
description: A lightweight, protective gel. Has properties of Fell magic. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Mist of a Fell Sicklescythe
description: A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell casters. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Enshrouded Cyclops Eye
description: A massive, unblinking eye brimming with Shroud power. Its overwhelming energy is a critical element in crafting exotic high-level armor. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

name: Shroud Adhesive
description: A thick, viscous substance harvested from Shroud Flayers. Its tenacious bonding properties make it essential for crafting armor and securely sticking materials together in various crafting recipes.
acquisition_hint: Shroud Flayer, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

name: Ivy
description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

name: Climbing Rose
description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

name: Monstrous Ribs
description: Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Monstrosity, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

name: Mycelium
description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

name: Active Mycelium
description: The active mycelium of mushrooms absorbs the Shroud's magical properties. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?

name: Fell Heart
description: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Sporehead, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud

name: Giant Critter Scales
description: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Critter Queen, First: Revelwood Shroud

name: Petrified Shroud Stalker Shell
description: A dense, stone-like carapace torn from the Stalker, a ruthless assassin of the Shroud. Its near-unbreakable structure makes it a crucial material for forging tough and resilient armor. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
acquisition_hint: Shroud Stalker, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

name: Fresh Shroud Spore
description:
Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

They first appear in the Springlands at night, among groups of Fell enemies above the Shroud.

name: Calla Luna
description:
A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. 
However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Shadowbloom
description: The Shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange glowing petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.

name: Glimmer Gentian
description:
"Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night.

It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.

name: Stapelia Starflower
description:
A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death.

Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.

name: Ectoplasm Cluster
description: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.

name: Shroud Sand
description: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.

name: Raw Rice
description: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!

name: Coffee Beans
description: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor!

name: Roasted Coffee Beans
description: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

name: Ground Coffee Beans
description: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!

name: Aquamarine
description: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.

name: Aquamarine Dust
description: Finely ground Aquamarine crystals that sparkle beautifully.

name: Green Vitriol Dust
description: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.

name: Pearl
description: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.

name: Mother-Of-Pearl
description: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.

name: Gleam Root
description:
An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

It can be found beneath the water in the Veilwater Basin.

name: Gleam Root Dust
description: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

name: Capybara Bristles
description: These capybara bristles can be woven into your clothing to help you glide through the water more easily and prevent you from cooling down too quickly.

name: Gold Dust
description: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

name: Gold Bars
description: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

name: Gold Ore
description: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the waves don't.

name: Water Reptile Hide
description: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from amphibians that prefer wet or water-filled environments.

name: Water Reptile Leather
description: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.

name: Fish Bones
description: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

name: Bursting Fell Heart
description: It's oozing, unaturally enlarged, and still beating whenever you dare to look away. This heart's potent essence is a key ingredient in crafting resilient armor.
acquisition_hint: Fell Sporeseeker, First: Veilwater Basin Shroud

name: Passionflower
description: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.

name: Paper Reed
description: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.

name: Palm Leaves
description: Vibrant palm leaves that offer ample shade in the blazing sun. They can be used as a crafting ingredient.

name: Bamboo Logs
description: Sturdy, bendy, and regenerative: Bamboo is an ideal material for any Flameborn looking to build a tropical home.

name: Shroud Slime
description: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.

name: Orange Fabric
description: Orange dyed fabric used for clothing.

name: Daylily
description: An orange daylily flower. The petals are vibrant enough to be used for dyes.

name: Pink Mushroom Meat
description: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.

name: Shroud Relic
description: Contains a higher concentration of Shroud compared to Shroud Particles.
acquisition_hint: Fell Enemies, First: Veilwater Basin Shroud

name: Shroud Radiance
description: The highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus.

name: Fish Teeth
description: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

name: Wisteria
description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

name: Underwater Overgrowth
description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

name: Archaic Essence VI
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Drak Scales
description: Fresh and glistening Drak scales, shimmering and shifting in the golden glow of the sun.

name: Hydrak'Dal Head
description:
The head of a Drak'Dal tribe leader. You've severed it from its neck, but in its place, two new ones will form — figuratively speaking.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Iron Dust
description: Fine iron dust, used for different crafting purposes.

name: Drak Teeth
description: A collection of conical teeth. The Drak lose them aplenty throughout their lives, and fill the more permanent holes with gold implants or rage.

name: Drak Claws
description: Meant to hold and rip prey, these claws are still sharp as ever.

name: Drak Blood
description: Violet blood. It runs cold, and the consistency is somewhat syrupy.

name: Shroud Sludge
description:
Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge.
All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied viscosity.

name: Toxic Sack
description: A large gland filled with a lethal substance. Handle it with care!

name: Cursed Shroud Sack
description: A dangerous, rotting substance, made half-liquid by its state of decay.
acquisition_hint: Fell Vicious Vine, Veilwater Basin Shroud

name: Icy Giant Bones
description: Gigantic, sturdy, and bone-chilling.

name: Venom Stinger
description: A sharp, organic stinger. Don't get pricked, or you'll have venom rushing through your veins!
acquisition_hint: Veilwater Basin Enemies and Cinder's Cradle Crops

name: Tropical Wood
description: This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!

name: Hollow Titan Head
description: The Hollow Titan wears no face, only a featureless mask, with his plume swaying slightly with each step.

name: Electric Nerve
description: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.

name: Wet Boot
description: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.

name: Piscine Ivory Dust
description: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.

name: Exceptional Ectoplasm
description: Despite its wild mixture, it still looks appealing. It's one of those things that isn't edible, yet you still want to take a bite out of it.

name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm
description: A curious blend. Ground, mixed and left to settle. The important thing is that it works. Probably.

name: Ectoplasm Aggregate
description: A massive formation of ectoplasm crystals, pulsing with energy. An enormous life force is trapped within — and has been for a very long time.

name: Basalt Dust
description: Ground from dense volcanic rock and very rich in minerals.

name: Celestium Ore
description: Upon meteorite impact, vast Celestium deposits were born deep within Cinder's Cradle.

name: Celestium Bars
description: A bar of refined Celestium. Its surface shifts between deep violet and pale blue.

name: Diamond
description: Born from unimaginable heat and weight, diamond endures what would destroy anything else. Every facet tells a different story.

name: Diamond Dust
description: Ground down but not less sturdy. Every fragment catches light and splits it into cold blues and flickers of gold.

name: Moonstone
description: No one has ever cut one from rock — only found where the Ancients have passed. Maybe they've brought it to Embervale from wherever they originated.

name: Moonstone Dust
description: Fine particles that shimmer faintly, leaving a cold blue trace on whatever they settle on.

name: Sparkling Dust
description:
Diamond pulled from deep below. Moonstone fallen from somewhere far above. Mother-Of-Pearl drawn from the ocean floor. 
Three materials that would have never met, ground together into something that catches light from every direction at once, warm and cold, and shifting all at the same time.

name: Archaic Essence VII
description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

name: Archaic Shards
description: Jagged fragments of dense metal. Too irregular to smelt cleanly, too valuable to discard.

name: Archaic Core
description: Pulled from the chest of a fallen construct, it still hums faintly. It's heavier than it looks. Whatever made them move lives inside that.

name: Shortcrust Pastry Base
description: Perfectly crisp and buttery — a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.

name: Raw Meat and Corncob Skewer
description: A hearty feast that fortifies your body. Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

name: Raw Meat and Mushroom Skewer
description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

name: Raw Meat and Tomato Skewer
description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

name: Direwolf Head
description: The severed head of a ginormous wolf. It must have belonged to some pack leader.

name: Fell Striker Head
description: The head of a Fell Striker. The eyes have been fully absorbed into fungal growth... so they're blinded by more than rage.

name: Hollow Wispwyvern Head
description: It broke your bones with bones. Seemed only fair to take a few of its own. The head's still intact — makes for a decent trophy.

name: Magma Gel
description: A thick gel that sets harder than it looks. Can be applied as a protective coating over most surfaces. Notably, it also generates heat from within.

name: Archaic Infusion
description: Refined from materials that predate recorded history, this infusion carries properties that resist easy explanation. The Ancient Researcher knows what to do with it.

name: Ember Carapace
description: Heat-hardened scales from a carapace creature of Cinder's Cradle. Blades skate off its surface, and flames find nothing to catch.

name: <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>'s Eye
description: A massive ocular core, torn from <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>, or what was left of him. Inside, faint arcs of energy still flicker.

name: Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eye
description: The grand eye that mounted the Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct just moments before now lays in your hands. The fused metal plates and ancient machinery are fascinating.

name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Head
description: It looks oddly similar to the Fell Critter Queen, just a different color.

name: Fell Critter Queen Head
description: The Fell Critter Queen Head looks strangely small without the bulk that had once followed behind it.

name: Scavenger Tyrant Head
description: Her seven glowing red eyes still carry an unsettling weight, but her whip is gone, her power stripped away. You can take her head without worry now.

name: Vorgoth's Bound Essence
description: Certain protection demands something personal. Use this bound essence to craft Vorgoth's Armor.

name: Fish Scales
description: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.

name: Fish Poison Gland
description: Potent in small doses. A staple ingredient for poison-based concoctions.

name: Raw Meat and Azure Russula Skewer
description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

name: Raw Meat and Forest Beet Skewer
description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

name: Raw Meat and Hazelnut Skewer
description: A hearty feast that fortifies your body. Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

name: Scavenger Scattershot Head
description: You hold it in your hand — the Elixir still dripping from its fanged mouth. It's finally over.

name: Scavenger Artificer Head
description: The severed head of the Scavenger Artificer. Without its harpoon or turret you have nothing to worry about.

name: Summoning Staff
description: Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.

name: Ramone Jones
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Gunther Galeforth
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Oscar Godwin
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Anton Godwin
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Robert Gibson
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Hugo Vanderhall
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Hannah Reed
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Marianne Reed
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Gabrielle Fairburn
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Kaori Conway
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Mei-Yin Chen
description: Mei-Yin Chen is a Lunar New Year trader offering seasonal wares. She also sells copies of cosmetic clothing items.

name: Captain Melville Fontane
description: Captain Melville Fontane is a fisher and entrepreneur who offers fishing gear.

name: Loraine Crim
description: Loraine Crim is an Ancient researcher and adventure enthusiast.

name: Captain Whiskers
description:
This cat is as dark as the midnight sky and its charming demands for attention never go unanswered. It purrs loudly whenever you are near! 

The Scavengers that kept this cat were unsure whether to call it "Captain" or "Whiskers".

name: Ruffles
description: A loud, energetic dog with sunny fur that yearns for connection. Its tail hasn't stopped wagging ever since you freed it from its cage. The Scavengers that owned this dog previously called it "Ruffles".

name: Pompom Jr.
description:
A timid little fellow with spotted fur. It was found in an empty Kindlewastes home. 

The woman that lived in the house before had many dogs, and her favorite was called "Pompom". Maybe this dog is one of its descendants!

name: Ikko
description:
A happy and carefree dog that likes to sleep in. It loves belly rubs and madly dashing in your general direction every time it sees you. 

You found this dog in a tower ruled by Hollow hounds, and a Hollow Warlock. The Warlock seemingly tried to create a vessel for a companion named "Ikko". You interrupted their ritual — but the name stuck.

name: Tyger
description: This striped cat is a fearsome hunter, always on the prowl. It's quiet, graceful, independent — and proud to present its spoils of war to you after a successful hunt! After a long day of adventuring though, it loves nothing more than to snuggle and sleep.

name: Sapphire
description: Despite its angelic looks, this sugary sweet cinnamon-colored cat is a gleeful little rascal who likes getting into trouble! You can never be too mad, though. Just look at those beautiful, sapphire blue eyes!

name: Common Goat
description: This animal can supply you with fresh milk.

name: Flightless Redtail
description: A Flightless Redtail with colorful feathers and a strong, regal beak. You can keep it in captivity indefinitely for eggs, and it can't even fly away.

name: Hophare
description: A curious, but shy Hophare. Their timid nature and quick reflexes protect them from predators!

name: Fae Deer
description: An adult Fae Deer. It loves head pats!

name: Dune Armadillo
description: This species constantly regenerates its outer shell, allowing for the collection of scales.

name: Yak
description: This woolly fellow grows a thick coat to weather the harsh climate of Albaneve Summits. It can be shaved for wool.

name: Frizzy Goat
description: A mature Frizzy Goat that can provide milk.

name: Round-Billed Sailer
description: A fully grown Round-Billed Sailer, willing to donate fresh feathers for your cause.

name: Capybara
description: An adorable Capybara. It's entirely unbothered while in your arms. The bristles can be used in crafting.

name: Baby Fae Deer
description: A baby Fae Deer. They are fragile after birth, but they learn to walk and gallop astonishingly quickly!

name: Baby Common Goat
description: A cute baby Common Goat. They tend to rub their heads against your leg for attention.

name: Baby Dune Armadillo
description: This baby Dune Armadillo is already starting to form its horn, later used for digging tunnels — never when you're looking, though. It's strange how that works.

name: Baby Yak
description: A baby Yak, fluffy and warm.

name: Baby Flightless Redtail
description: A small, round Flightless Redtail baby. Even at this age, their beak can cause some damage. Don't get pecked!

name: Baby Hophare
description: An adorable little Hophare. Its eyes frantically scan the environment when you pick it up, but it calms down quickly.

name: Baby Frizzy Goat
description: An adorable little Frizzy Goat. Its hair gets easily tangled, but it doesn't seem to mind.

name: Baby Round-Billed Sailer
description: A young Round-Billed Sailer, unable to fly yet due to its overly round shape and tiny wings.

name: Baby Capybara
description: A tiny Capybara. It enjoys headpats, chewing on daylilies, soaking in hot springs, and being held tightly in your warm arms.

name: Balthazar
description: The <npc>Alchemist</npc> Balthazar brews potions and other concoctions.

name: Emily Fray
description: The <npc>Farmer</npc> Emily Fray crafts food and helps you grow your plants.

name: Valory
description: The adventuring Bard, Valory, carves instruments and shares exciting tales from her travels through Embervale.

name: Cade Hawthorn
description: The <npc>Carpenter</npc> Cade Hawthorn can craft anything with wood.

name: Oswald Anders
description: The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> Oswald Anders crafts and upgrades armors and weapons.

name: Athalan Skree
description: The <npc>Hunter</npc> Athalan Skree helps you to build armors and creates equipment for survival.

name: Alden Crowley
description: The Collector, Alden Crowley, can create mystical and dark furniture sets and food items infused with a special, revitalizing energy.

name: Lady Leclair
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Rochelle Anders
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Aunt Braelyn
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Fenrig Mills, Jr.
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Galen Yager
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Elio Ricci
description: The Barber, Elio Ricci, allows you to change your appearance.

name: Chester Loft
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Nameless One
description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

name: Construction Hammer
description: Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly erecting various structures around your home. Can only be used within the range of a Flame Altar.

name: Wood Foundation
description: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

name: Overgrowth Tool
description: A magical tool capable of adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. It can only be used within Flame Altar range and requires overgrowth material.

name: Decay Tool
description: A magical tool capable of adding and removing signs of decay to walls in your base. It can only be used within Flame Altar range.

name: Sparkworks Tool
description: An Ancient tool that allows the user to wire up buttons, doors, traps, and more to make them interactable and logically interconnected.

name: Improved Decay Tool
description: A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing broken-looking edges to walls in your base. Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

name: Improved Overgrowth Tool
description: A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

name: Improved Construction Hammer
description: A magical tool powered by the Flame. It enables you to fly while building various structures for your base. Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

name: Flame Altar
description: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

name: Explosive Barrel
description: A decorative element that creates an explosive atmosphere, indeed.

name: Vukah Brawler Trophy
description:
The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
Good omens fell to ash. Lights turned to lies, not promises. What was once a sign of good fortune has been snuffed out by a brush with fate. <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s glory is restored.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Hollow Cyclops Trophy
description: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!

name: Iron Scavenger Matron Trophy
description:
Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description:
Even when dead, the swirling chaos inside the gaping maw leaves people spellbound. Don't get too close.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Bronze Hollow Cyclops Trophy
description:
When encased in solid bronze, the head looks even more menacing than before.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description:
Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. Its lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Iron Vukah Brawler Trophy
description:
Every thundering roar is a spectacle, a bloody sight to behold. They've sunk their tusks into now-forgotten lands... time to reclaim the kingdom.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Vukah Brawler Trophy
description:
Battle-hardened and brutish, the beastly Vukah would create their Brawlers through constant clashes. Only the strongest survived.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description:
Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description:
Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description:
The Sicklescythe's tongue froze once struck down, too powerless to cast the final curse stuck in its throat.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Hollow Cyclops Trophy
description:
New iron teeth now line its disturbing grin. 

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
The scales are heavy with muck and grime, dulling its glow. Hard to believe such a being once illuminated the water lilies under <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s glorious rule.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description:
Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Scavenger Matron Trophy
description:
It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Trophy.

name: Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description:
Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter — of sanity and sanctum.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description:
Even the most gruesome creatures must bend to the Flame, no matter their size. At least the slushing sounds inside its dome have subsided.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description:
No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Scavenger Matron Trophy
description:
The inside of the helmet is strangely damp. There's sticky residue everywhere.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Fell Cyclops Trophy
description: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

name: Iron Fell Cyclops Trophy
description:
The prized head of a cyclops, preserved in metal and made accessible to the common person. People can now gaze into its eye unafraid.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Cyclops Trophy
description:
A mesmerizing display of overwhelming power, and little intelligence.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Bronze Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description:
Ages ago, they were many — soaring across snowy peaks and through painterly valleys. Now, there is only one. Oh, how far you fall when flying high.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description: A lonely soul, brought low by the Shroud — and set free by your blade.

name: Iron Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description:
The last dragon's head. The final nail in the coffin. The end of an era, and the start of something new.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Bronze Cyclops Trophy
description:
Their faces are frightening, but they mostly just want to herd goats and yaks. People only make up a small portion of their diet. 

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Cyclops Trophy
description: A severed Cyclops Head, still wearing a helmet, although that's hardly needed now.

name: Iron Cyclops Trophy
description:
Large, in charge, and ready to barge in while you are busy scavenging caves.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Hydrak'Dal Trophy
description:
A severed Hydrak'Dal Head with a regal headdress. Even now, it still exudes authority and a will to dominate.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Trophy.

name: Bronze Hydrak'Dal Trophy
description:
The Hydrak'Dal would surely be outraged that you covered his golden decorations with bronze. Fortunately, he can no longer complain.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Hydrak'Dal Trophy
description:
When you stand opposite this face, you remember its screams. "Zzzrrr Krrrraallllll Hrrrrggg" it echoes in your head, only this time you don't have to feel weak in the knees.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Hydrak'Dal Trophy
description:
This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Cyclops Trophy
description:
Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Cyclops Trophy
description:
There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description:
As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description:
Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description:
The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description:
Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Scavenger Matron Trophy
description:
Completely gilded, you no longer notice the dirt and stench, so you can hang it in your living room without hesitation.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Hollow Cyclops Trophy
description:
The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Gold Vukah Brawler Trophy
description:
Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Hollow Titan Trophy
description: The bare helmet of the Hollow Titan. At its crown rises a stiff plume.

name: Bronze Hollow Titan Trophy
description:
The Bronze Hollow Titan Head carries a warm, dull sheen into your home.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Hollow Titan Trophy
description:
The plume becomes rigid and jagged, like frozen spikes. You don't have to worry; they won't attack you anymore.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Hollow Titan Trophy
description:
The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Direwolf Trophy
description: The Direwolf's Head dominates the wall, it's sheer scale dwarfing any common wolf beside it.

name: Bronze Direwolf Trophy
description:
Cast entirely in bronze, every savage detail of the Direwolf has been immortalized in cold metal.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Direwolf Trophy
description:
The snarling lips and crushing fangs remind you of the countless fights you had with the Direwolf.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Direwolf Trophy
description:
The golden Direwolf does not show that it was victorious — it shows that you were.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>'s Eye Trophy
description: When placed, the eye slowly becomes something more than just a core again. Thin layers of skin reform around it, forming a heavy eyelid that never fully closes.

name: Bronze <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>'s Eye Trophy
description:
Bronze seeps into the newly formed flesh, binding eyelid and tendrils into a unified shell.

Collect multiple <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>'s Eye Trophy
description:
The internal glow is dim and struggling against confinement.

Collect multiple <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>'s Eye Trophy
description:
Gold smooths over the jagged form, giving it an almost sacred appearance. The tendrils resemble ornamental roots rather than organic tissue. This trophy shows you are the greatest Flameborn of all time, because you did not back down from fighting evil more than once. You did it multiple times and were successful.

Collect multiple <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
description: You don't need to worry about a sudden flash of light tearing through the air anymore. That era is gone.

name: Bronze Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
description:
The waves of projectiles raining down on you are still a vivid memory. But this eye won't hurt you no more.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
description:
In its iron covered form the structure becomes heavier and more rigid, its surface darkened and sealed.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
description:
The central eye remains visible, but no longer carries the pressure it once did. It now feels less like a weapon and more like a relic.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description: Her red glowing head is smaller than your memory suggested and her mandibles less threatening.

name: Bronze Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description:
Even molten bronze poured on top of her head couldn't dull her features. Her body remains a deep crimson, and her eyes glow with the same unsettling red as before.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description:
It's quite unsettling that her intense stare and her burning eyes won't fade. They keep on watching you.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description:
Take this golden trophy as a sign of your multiple victories, but also remember: she won't stop staring back, she refuses to be covered, and to be forgotten.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.

name: Bronze Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description:
The Fell Critter Queen's Head mounted on a wall and covered in bronze seems more ornamental than threatening.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description:
When you now look at the Fell Critter Queen's Head you wouldn't think that she once was powerful enough to command an entire swarm.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description:
You have slain the Fell Critter Queen so many times that her golden trophy can embellish your walls. One could say you have earned the right to take her place and be the new Queen. But there was nobody left to rule.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
description: Her whip still haunts you in your dreams so you chose to hang her head instead.

name: Bronze Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
description:
Each of her glowing eyes feels like a remnant of one of her whips — echoes of a violence that is no longer there.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
description:
Her eyes don't move, yet they seem to follow you all the same. It feels less like being watched, more like being measured.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
description:
For a moment, you're back on the battlefield. Her presence brings the same tension into the room, as if the fight never quite ended.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
description: The Scavenger Scattershot used to spin toward you like a storm. Now he just hangs there, still.

name: Bronze Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
description:
Looking at his teeth up close, you're almost grateful he stuck to throwing scrap.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
description:
You dreaded the moment he opened his elixir bottle. Without a stomach, it's not going anywhere now.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
description:
He spun, he threw his scrap balls, and drank his way through every fight he had. But in the end, none of it was enough. This trophy is proof of your victory.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Scavenger Artificer Trophy
description: Thinking back at the fight, you can feel the pull of his harpoon, which you cannot escape. Luckily, now when you don't want to be close to him again, you can just leave the room.

name: Bronze Scavenger Artificer Trophy
description:
The Scavenger Artificer builds, and you suffer the consequences. Now you build with his head. How the tables have turned!

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Scavenger Artificer Trophy
description:
The craftsman in you has created a masterpiece. This iron trophy is a true work of art. Perhaps the Scavenger Artificer would be proud, too, if only he could still speak.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Scavenger Artificer Trophy
description:
He reeled you in every time. Not anymore. His head's gilded and mounted, for good.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Fell Striker Trophy
description: This fight made you stop believing in safe corners. You can be sure that he always closes the gap between you two. Maybe nailed to your walls, he will finally leave you be.

name: Bronze Fell Striker Trophy
description:
Standing far away didn't save you in the fight. Now you don't have to worry about the distance between you; you can admire the bronze-glazed head from up close.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Fell Striker Trophy
description:
By now you know that running to the back isn't a winning strategy; it's just an invitation for him to get the better of you.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Fell Striker Trophy
description:
The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
description: You stare at the skull and swear the floor trembles. It doesn't. Yet.

name: Bronze Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
You checked twice for a pulse, just to make sure it's dead. Skeletons normally don't have one, and this one is covered in bronze... You're probably in the clear.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

name: Iron Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
Some fights leave scars. Others leave a fear of the undead.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

name: Gold Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
description:
At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury — and this trophy is proof of it.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

name: The Dragons' Map
description: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

name: Tome of the First Flameborn
description: A gilded tome, emblazoned with a large "E". It tells the story of the original Flameborn and how they shaped Embervale as we know it. Every river or peak, ruin and castle, fight and fable was crafted with their support, and in their honor. Our world would not exist without them. The last words on the final page simply read "Thank you for everything."
