name: Round Sea Urchin
description:
Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

name: Smaller Sea Lily Fossil
description:
A robust, small sea lily fossil. No matter how you turn it, you're always greeted by a tendril or imprint.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Gastropods
description:
These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons — together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

name: Trilobites
description:
Multiple ancient trilobites, perfectly still and preserved in a petrified coat of sediment.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

name: Big Ammonite
description:
An impressively big ammonite fossil. The remains of this marine cephalopod once housed a large, tentacled, sea-bound creature. In Embervale superstition, every identifiable rim extending from the spiral's core is said to bestow a day of good luck.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

name: Ammonite Imprint
description:
A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

name: Dull Shark Tooth
description:
A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Larger Sea Lily Fossil
description:
A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Elevated Sea Urchin
description:
This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal. 

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

name: Trilobite Imprint
description:
A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

name: Sharp Shark Tooth
description:
A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

name: Fish Fossil
description:
The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendants of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

name: Single Gastropod
description:
A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

name: Sea Urchin Cluster
description:
A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers — but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

name: Crab Fossil
description:
Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

name: Prawn Fossil
description:
The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers — but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

name: Mysterious Tome
description: A mysterious old book that cannot be opened. No matter how hard you pull at the petrified covers, the tome doesn't seem willing to spill its secrets.

name: Bound Tome
description: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.

name: Tome of Agony
description: This dusty old tome emanates a silent hate, restrained by thick iron shackles. Every fortnight, whenever this book is near, a spirited chain rattle fills the midnight air, and the pages inside convulse. It's as if something was trying to leap off the parchment to turn from ink to flesh and blood.

name: Foreboding Golden Urn
description: A golden urn with intricate ornaments in the shape of an eerie skull. The lateral detailing resembles fangs or claws.

name: Bejeweled Golden Urn
description: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...

name: Inscribed Golden Urn
description: This golden urn has multiple sigils inscribed on it. Their meaning far exceeds modern understanding, but scholars would presume these to be magical wards.

name: Large Dark Crystal
description: A large crystal with a threatening aura.

name: Dark Crystal Cluster
description: A cluster of dark crystals, growing together. They reach into different directions like the finger bones of the undead, clawing themselves out of their graves.

name: Sparkling Dark Crystal
description: When gazing upon the crystal's surface, you feel the mirror image warp and shift into something... unsettling.

name: Cyclops Skull
description:
A gruesome, skeletal Cyclops head. You can fit your entire fist through the giant eyehole!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Cyclops Torso
description:
A cozy Cyclops ribcage with enough room for you and your best mate to snuggle up in.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Left Cyclops Arm
description:
It's the left arm of a fearsome Cyclops. These skeletal fists could still crush you.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Right Cyclops Arm
description:
The right arm of a Cyclops. It's taller than your whole body when propped up!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Left Cyclops Leg
description:
This left Cyclops leg is much taller than you. You barely reach the kneecaps.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Right Cyclops Leg
description:
The right leg of a wild Cyclops. The skeletal remains are intact.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Cyclops Pelvis
description:
A bony Cyclops pelvis. It's eerie.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

name: Drak Relief II
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.

name: Drak Relief I
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.

name: Drak Relief III
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients.

The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.

name: Drak Relief IV
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.

name: Drak Relief V
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon— a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.

name: Drak Relief VI
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.

name: Drak Relief VII
description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.

name: Revelwood Miniature Piece
description:
A miniature piece that shows the Revelwood, part of Meldore. It used to be a vibrant area where the rivers flowed with wine, and the trees would shade the weary. Eventually, though, abuse of the Elixir spread, and the roots that once brought life to the Kingdom began to rot.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Springlands Miniature Piece
description:
A model of the Springlands, the place where everything began. Green rolling hills, the smell of honey in the air, and clear skies above — but life couldn't stay this peaceful. Not for a Flameborn, anyway.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Blackmire Miniature Piece
description:
A piece of the Blackmire, the long-forgotten woods. While there are no human settlements here, it is absolutely teeming with life... and mystery.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Nomad Highlands Miniature Piece
description:
The Nomad Highlands were once filled to the brim with traveling merchants, gold, and greed. It was glorious, bustling, and rotten to the core before the Shroud ever came along.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Kindlewastes Miniature Piece
description:
This model of the Kindlewastes shows sandy dunes and rugged cliffs, but Orindell wasn't always like this. Perhaps this scorching expanse would have looked different if water hadn't stopped flowing through its veins.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Albaneve Summits Miniature Piece
description:
Snow-covered mountains and frozen lakes adorn this model of the summits. A shame the Dragon youngling, or the "winged beast", as soldiers would say, cannot be seen. Perhaps it rests inside Howling Peak, dreaming of frolicking with others of its kind.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Veilwater Basin Miniature Piece
description:
A model of the Veilwater Basin, complete with glistening lakes, bloodthirsty Drak, and Coconana smoothies. A treacherous paradise — what could you want more from life?

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Cinder's Cradle Miniature Piece
description:
A tabletop map piece that shows Cinder's Cradle, the home of the Ancients. Years ago, they would have filled the quiet air between the daring basalt spikes with theories, deliberations, and heated debates... but now, everything is still.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

name: Iron Meteorite
description: A dense chunk of nickel and iron. The slow cooling over millions of years formed its crystal bands — the Widmanstätten structure.

name: Pallasite
description: Peridot crystals suspended in a nickel-iron matrix. The pallasite is one of the rarest meteorites.

name: Chondrite
description: Chondrites are the most common kind of starfall. They look grainy and unremarkable, but they are older than the sun.

name: Mesosiderite
description: The mesosiderite consists of a rough mix of metal and stone. They likely resulted from a crash between two asteroids.

name: Achondrite
description: Achondrites consist of melted rock. They originate from bigger asteroids or even other planets.

name: Large Chondrite
description: Chondrites are the most common kind of starfall. They look grainy and unremarkable, but they are older than the sun.

name: Large Mesosiderite
description: The mesosiderite consists of a rough mix of metal and stone. They likely resulted from a crash between two asteroids.

name: Beginning Of The End
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Long ago, a wanderer brought an enthralling gift to the people of Embervale." I so wonder what sort of day it was — I chose to paint the sky as overcast; but whether the air was joyous or heavy, I could not know... - J

name: Servant Of Chaos
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "The Elixir. It was a cure, a blessing, a weapon." His frame nearly subsumes the Elixir. They bleed into each other; one dark shape against the sky... He was both peddler and prophet — but what for? - J

name: Initiation
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Once concealed by the Ancients, its might had been set free." This one's for you, Brother. I wonder... did the Wanderer speak these same words when he handed you your favorite toy? I imagine you leaning back, almost lounging in that throne like you used to. I miss that side of you. - J

name: Above The Vermin, The Cowards, The Liars
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "With it came power, mistrust, and a longing for more." "Levitation", you said. I could not believe my ears, but you were never one to jest, so I took you at your word. What did it feel like? Was it bright and sharp? Weightless and warm? Suffocating and unsteady? Maybe a little bit of everything. - J

name: Gift Of Violence
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Humanity dug the Elixir Wells, ripping apart the land and each other to quench their thirst." When you told me of your family's pain, it reminded me of that of my own people. We're so quick to tear each other to shreds, aren't we? Some will fight for scraps and die with nothing. I wish you the best. -J

name: Ashes Of Pikemead's Reach
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Elixir and blood, a drop for a drop." You did not hear me when last we spoke. Maybe imagery will reach you, Manny. Sorry. I know you hate it when I call you that. - J

name: A Spiral Down, Down, Down
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "But from the depths of the Wells an unforeseen curse swept into Embervale." A horrible nightmare of mine. I could not rest until I had put it to canvas... but now, I can't stand to look at it. -J

name: The Horde Unleashed
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "The Shroud, a ruinous fog which sought only to spread and devour." It's a terrifying sight... but packed tightly against the light of the morning sun. I wanted to show that there is still hope... somewhere out there. - J

name: Jezmina's Journey Begins
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Facing their downfall, Ancients and humans united to forge the Flameborn." It was difficult to capture the likeness of my Ancient companions... and my own, too, no less! My hair has gotten so long. I did not even realize until I brought it on canvas! - J

name: The Last Spark
description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "A flaming soul in a mortal body, nurtured amongst the ashes of a dying world. Now, your time has come. Awake!" My final piece: The last spark, the hearth of hope, the beginning of a new era. I wanted to paint the Flameborn directly, but I cannot begin to fathom what they will look like. Maybe I will get to meet them one day... then, I'll paint them a proper portrait! Until then, I hope you keep this painting safe, friends. - J

name: Club of Defiance

name: Banebringer

name: Undergrowth Staff

name: Arsonist's Bow

name: White Wolf Sword

name: Wolf Pack Axe

name: Noble Sword

name: Spine Splinter

description: The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.

name: Protector Greatsword

name: New Moon Greatsword

name: Wooden Tooth

name: Meat Chopper

name: Antler Bow

name: Composite Bow

name: Brisk Bow

name: Ignited Hammer

name: Deeproot Axe

name: Aerostriker

name: Shadowbane

name: Bonebreaker

name: Sword of Radiance

name: Stonewrought Sword

Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Fine Copperblade Greatsword
description: A blade forged from the pure, reflective copper commonly found in the Revelwood. While you can spy a hint of patina across its body, there's no noticeable discoloration.

name: Chimerical Greatsword
description: A weapon born from the amalgamation of bones, earth, and liquid fire. As your eyes travel across it, the mess of cartilage and moss at the hilt gives way to a light-swallowing obsidian blade.

name: Ironheart Greatsword
description: An iron core lies hidden inside the blade's casing, peeking out from the silver curtains on the blade's flat.

name: Bronze-engraved Greatsword
description: A formidable greatsword, forged with a copper and tin alloy. Its maker took the time to carefully etch harmoniously flowing lines into it, which spill from the ricasso towards the centre of the blade.

name: Silver Haze
description: A wand with the power to command ice-cold lightning. It coats the air around it in a silvery sheen. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Extinguished Sword

name: Sun Axe
description: An axe that shines brightest at dawn, clinging on to hope no matter what.

name: Traitor's Bow
description: This bow fires easily against creatures of the Shroud.

name: Gleaming Staff
description: A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Ignited Bow
description: Ignited by the Flame itself, this bow pulses with the power of fire.

name: Iron Claw Club

name: Rotblood

name: Deceiving Staff

name: Dark Cleaver

name: Fearsome Club
description: This club strikes fear into the hearts of your foes with every swing.

name: Sunbeam

name: Major Arcana

name: Greater Thunderblast Axe

name: Amber Bow

name: Lumenshade Axe

description: No matter how dire the night may be, with the rising sun comes sweet morning dew.

name: Sickle Greatsword
description:
Once upon a time, Orpheus, a dark dragon, descended from the mountains to wreak havoc on the people's crops. Determined, the farmers laid down their scythes to join in the righteous crusade against the creature, forcing it to retreat with but one blow.
While their names were forgotten, their fabled blades served as inspiration for many blacksmith apprentices.

name: Princely Greatsword
description: A noble sabre that impresses with its golden glow and broad blade. Perhaps the former owner was compensating for something.

name: Goldlaced Greatsword
description: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterened edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.

name: Proud Daggers
description: Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor. name: Grey Blades

name: Rune Apprentice's Sword
description: The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.

name: Steel Moon Axe
description: An axe with two perfectly rounded, balanced steel blades. They nearly form the shape of the full moon.

name: Bright Morningstar
description: A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.

name: Horned Beast Bow
description: A bow crafted to resemble the horned beasts of the Albaneve Summits. It makes for a fearsome silhouette.

name: Celestial Axe
description: An ice-cold axe with a central, vibrant gem. Its blades are adorned with small spikes to cause maximum damage. When this axe rains down on its enemies, it beautifully reflects the sun's light.

name: Staff of the Taurus
description: A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Parade Daggers

Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Dark Morningstar

name: Blizzard Wand

name: Ruffian's Axe
description: A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon will do the trick.

name: Champion's Axe
description: A hefty two-handed axe, usually wielded by champions of the ring! Axes like these are often a status symbol and represent triumph.

name: Rune Master's Sword
description: The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.

name: Ice-Coated Daggers

It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow. 
Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.

name: Snowflake Splicer

name: Mace of Wrath
description: In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and weed out the weak.

name: Mace of Denial

name: Aurora Sword

name: Icicle Sword
description: A sleek silvery sword, slim and reflective like a pure icicle.

name: Goat Hammer
description: A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected!

name: Battering Ram Hammer
description: A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!

name: Devilish Bow
description: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.

name: Scholar's Wand
description: Scholars of the North once researched the use of pyromagic against particularly harsh yearfall. It took countless explosive experiments to discover the same benefit most people might achieve with a bonfire. Downsides, such as third-degree burns, were common, so research was quickly stopped. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

The scouting went well until the Cyclopes learned that the torchbearers were feeble mages whose light could be snuffed out easily with a decisive boulder toss. description: The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.

description: The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.

name: Wolf's Fang Shield
description: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.

name: Wolf's Fang Shield
description: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.

name: Invisible Barrier Ward
description: With this ward, you can conjure a nearly invisible barrier that can keep you from harm in a time of need.

name: Invisible Barrier Ward
description: With this ward, you can conjure a nearly invisible barrier that can keep you from harm in a time of need.

name: Sunpiercer Shield
description: A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.

name: Sunpiercer Shield
description: A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.

name: Golden Bulwark Shield
description: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

name: Golden Bulwark Shield
description: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

name: Prismatic Ward
description: A ward that refracts all incoming light. Some say it creates a colorful prismatic effect when the conditions are right.

name: Prismatic Ward
description: A ward that refracts all incoming light. Some say it creates a colorful prismatic effect when the conditions are right.

name: Incredible Ward
description: A strong magic shield with a near-impenetrable barrier. The Ancients may have used this invention long ago, but they most likely discarded it in favor of other research projects.

name: Incredible Ward
description: A strong magic shield with a near-impenetrable barrier. The Ancients may have used this invention long ago, but they most likely discarded it in favor of other research projects.

name: Emberguard Shield
description: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

name: Emberguard Shield
description: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

name: Crestflame Shield
description: A bulky, circular shield that almost appears to possess a glowing energy core. With this, your defense will be powered up greatly!

name: Crestflame Shield
description: A bulky, circular shield that almost appears to possess a glowing energy core. With this, your defense will be powered up greatly!

name: Astrodome Shield
description: A convex shield, held by a bold yet delicate golden frame. Its design appears to be derived from the visual language and construction of telescopic lenses or compasses. Beneath the frame lies a faint constellation whose name and origin are unknown.

name: Astrodome Shield
description: A convex shield, held by a bold yet delicate golden frame. Its design appears to be derived from the visual language and construction of telescopic lenses or compasses. Beneath the frame lies a faint constellation whose name and origin are unknown.

name: Shield of Arisztar
description: Cubic metal pieces jut forth from an ivory base. Together, their interlocking layers create the silhouette of a wing. The shape and celestial design of the shield add to its origin mythos.

name: Shield of Arisztar
description: Cubic metal pieces jut forth from an ivory base. Together, their interlocking layers create the silhouette of a wing. The shape and celestial design of the shield add to its origin mythos.

name: Stormshield
description: A metal plate shield that was twisted and shaped in a Shroudstorm. It seems to be almost indestructible.

name: Stormshield
description: A metal plate shield that was twisted and shaped in a Shroudstorm. It seems to be almost indestructible.

name: <lorename>Jezmina</lorename>'s Apotheosis
description: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

name: Soothsayer
description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

name: Riptide
description: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

name: Cryptic Wand
description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Wailing Blade
description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

name: Shroud Weaver
description: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Talion's Bow
description: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

name: Fenrig's Axe
description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

name: Wolf's Hydra
description: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

name: Dreadbane
description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

name: Draconian Bow
description: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

name: Hailscourge
description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

name: <lorename>Lupa</lorename>'s Scalper
description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — <lorename>Lupa</lorename>" is etched on the side.

name: Reaper's Wand
description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Bulwark
description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

name: Dragon Sword
description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

name: Valor Heart Daggers
description: A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Ancestral Star
description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

name: Circus Knives
description: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
description: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
description: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

name: Golden War Hero Axe
description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

name: Golden Recruit Axe
description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

name: Staff Of The Serpent
description: A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Sword Of The Serpent
description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

name: Bow Of The Serpent
description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

name: Blessed Club
description: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

name: Dragonsbane
description:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

name: Dimweald Axe
description: A one-handed axe, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Lando, the secondborn. He was loyal to the end.

name: Dimweald Hammer
description: A mighty hammer, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Berhtolf, the firstborn son. Bravery was his downfall.

name: Darya's Wand
description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Darya's Staff
description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

description: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

name: <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Bulwark
description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

name: Riptide
description: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

name: Guard Of The North Sword
description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

name: Golden War Hero Axe
description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

name: Golden Recruit Axe
description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

name: Fenrig's Axe
description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

name: Staff Of The Serpent
description: A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: <lorename>Lupa</lorename>'s Scalper
description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — <lorename>Lupa</lorename>" is etched on the side.

name: <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Bulwark
description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

name: Riptide
description: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

name: <lorename>Jezmina</lorename>'s Apotheosis
description: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

name: Wolf's Hydra
description: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
description: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

name: Hailscourge
description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

name: Wailing Blade
description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
description: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

name: Dragon Sword
description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

name: Reaper's Wand
description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Darya's Wand
description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Cryptic Wand
description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Sword Of The Serpent
description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

name: Bow Of The Serpent
description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

name: Talion's Bow
description: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

name: Draconian Bow
description: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

name: Dragon's Wing
description: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

name: Circus Knives
description: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Valor Heart Daggers
description: A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Golden Recruit Axe
description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

name: Golden War Hero Axe
description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

name: Guard Of The North Sword
description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

name: Blessed Club
description: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

name: Ancestral Star
description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

name: Dreadbane
description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

name: Soothsayer
description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

name: Darya's Staff
description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Shroud Weaver
description: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Dragonsbane
description:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

name: Darya's Remorse
description: A wand that burns as bright as the sun. It's decorated with a flower that wraps around the handle, blooming near the hilt. Despite its radiance, it carries a dark energy — is it remorse, or the curse of the Shroud? Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Proto Matter-Bender
description: A traditional Ancient tool used to adjust the subject's physical matter or shell after arrival. It can also be used to unleash the full wonder of blunt force trauma. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Electric Initialiser
description: An electrifying wand that was previously used to start engines and machinery in an instant. The air crackles around it, and it has an odd shape. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Spearfisher Bow
description: Whether used to shoot birds from the sky or fish in the water, this bow is precise and vicious. It's definitely more stylish than a fishing rod, though it's less effective for the same purpose... perhaps its venom would be better used on other wildlife instead.

name: Breaching Bow
description: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.

name: Shroud Vessel's Greatsword
description: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.

name: Guard Of The North Sword
description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
