name: Breaching Bow
description: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.

name: Sinister Crescent Staff
description: A ritualistic staff that was cleansed in a still rivulet under a crescent moon. It serves the wielder to guide the undead back to the beyond. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Bonescourge Mace
description: This mace is the bane and banisher of all undead creatures. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Mandible Crusher
description: Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Snakespine Wand
description: A mythical wand formed around a winding vertebrae core. It strikes with deadly precision. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Spinechill Axe
description: A menacing axe that sends shivering chills down its victim's back with every heavy two-handed swing. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Sacrilegious Steelsword
description: A blade forged from the stolen steel of fallen soldiers. It spreads regret and misery. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Veilrift Axe
description: Every swing of this axe leaves a tear in the veil that separates the living from the beyond. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Silvershot Bow
description: A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.

name: Fool's Errand
description: You hear a faint whisper in the back of your head; unified in word, but spoken from a dozen tongues. A ghostly choir pleads with you. "Descending these dungeons is a fool's errand, can't you see? Turn back while you still can."

name: Fool's Demise
description: A voice reverberates through your bone marrow each time you grip the greatsword's handle. "King of fools, hear your fate foretold: Your skull shall shatter, and from within the hollow dome, you will gaze up through eyes rolled inwards at your soul; an incandescent fountain, spouting from the cracks."

name: Cursed Mocking Shield
description: This shield is adorned with a skull that spouts bloodcurdling mockery and jeers at your foes whenever you block their attacks. However, should you lose the upper hand in battle, its ridicule may fall upon you, too.

name: Final Gambit
description: A decisive strike, freshly spilled blood, and a silence that follows — such are the impressions of a fleeting rush. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Crown Crusher
description: The four-way cage around the mace's core forms an outward radiating crown when raised above the wielder's head. This serves as a final fanfare to victims before they're crushed at their ruler's feet. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Eclipsed Blade
description: Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Voidcaller
description: A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around... but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt? Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Winged Shadow
description: The arrow's shadow darts across the battlefield. Its presence is swift and fleeting, a daydream carried by a gust of wind — but its impact is precisely devastating. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Abysswalker
description: A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Oracle's Everblue
description: "Gaze into the orb," the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. "It shows the past, the present, and the future — and they're all veiled in blue rot". Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Half-Light Halos
description: Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Forked Tongue
description: A heavy blade that's split alongside the central ridge. Caution is advised, as some believe it to be a forked-tongued omen that taints the wielder's heart with lies. Yet, their caution spells weakness, and their words drip with envy... They would wield it if they could. Why shouldn't you? Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Rusty Short Sword
description: A forgotten sword from long-gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.

name: Soldier's Broadsword
description: A sharpened broadsword. Swinging it comfortably requires strong arms.

name: Short Sword
description: A basic short sword designed for fights in narrow areas. Remarkably agile with a sharp tip.

name: Provisional Scythe
description: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.

name: Vaporous Staff
description: A wild and withered staff, able to unleash the power of the earth. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Pyreblade
description: The Pyreblade is capable of unleashing devastating fire strikes while reflecting a portion of the foe’s own fury back upon them.

name: Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe
description: Those who wield the Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe command great awe — one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.

name: Scavenger Miner Axe
description: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone, or to pierce traitors’ backs.

name: Fell Marksman Bow
description: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Marksman Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.

name: Fell Scout Bow
description: Pierce Enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Scout Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.

name: Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword
description: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword — shrunken for your convenience.

name: Feathered Mace
description: Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.

name: Acid Cleaver
description: A cleaver coated with acid and bile, swung by Scavenger Butchers. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.

name: Fell Broad Sword
description: A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell soldiers and commanders.

name: Shroud Vessel's Greatsword
description: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.

name: Fell Black Knight Greatsword
description: The weapon of choice for Lord Vorgoth's personal guard. Blue lines follow the blade's body, carving around its peaks and valleys like the north winds.

name: Fell Defender Shield
description: A battered metal shield that allows you to block and parry physical attacks. Young squires tend to place all their hope in these... until the metal starts to bend and give. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

name: Fell Crusader Shield
description: A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up through many crusades.

name: Fell Black Knight Shield
description: A shield that unites the entire brute force of the North behind it. It opposes the Ancients and any fools who dare not to make way.

name: Fell Striker Greatsword
description: A blade commonly used by the Striker commando of the Fell. It's brutal, jagged, and efficient.

name: Fell Sentinel Bow
description: A bow wielded by the army's elite archers. No intruder dares to cross the sights of a Sentinel.

name: Scrap Shield
description: A crude shield made from the leftover metal scraps of the old world. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

name: Scrap Daggers
description: A pair of rudimentary and jagged Scavenger daggers. These are commonly wielded by the weakest of the pack, also called Scabs. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Beastmaster Shaman Staff
description: A wooden staff from which bioluminescent mushrooms sprout. In the hands of the Vukah, it holds the power to command beasts. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Lightning Shaman Staff
description: This staff is powered by an orb that attracts lightning during thunderstorms. It stores the captured electricity and can unleash it again at a later point. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Spearfisher's Shield
description: This wooden shield is not nearly intimidating enough for the young Spearfishers — therefore, they adorn their defenses with obsidian shards and glass plucked from the beaches.

name: Death Gazer Axe
description: Its crystal eye watches the battlefield, and those it fixes upon rarely see another dawn.

name: Wand Of Bloodflow
description: Winding grooves carve through the body of the wand, creating a canal for extracting the lifeblood of your enemies. Their energy will fuel you long after they've passed. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Totem Wand
description: A totem's grimace decorates this wand, watching your every move... sometimes, it empowers your magic. Sometimes, you feel it waiting for your downfall. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Explorer's Machete
description: A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.

name: Drakling Daggers
description: These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Adorned Drakling Daggers
description: Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Stormbound Staff
description: The staff's material is engraved with countless labyrinthine lines reminiscent of the chaotic flow of battle. However, a metal halo encircles the negative space within, preserving a sense of calm, as if one were inside the eye of a storm. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Apex Machete
description: The weapon brandishes an interlocking pattern of dark and light by partially covering its fuller with a blackened outer shell. The sword's sides are asymmetric, making one ideal for slashing while the other excels in prying or hacking through its pronounced claw-like appendage.

name: Megalodon Greatsword
description: You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?

name: Freshblood Mace
description: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth — this process is represented through the design of this mace.

name: Fallen Wing Axe
description: Don't be fooled by its name, this axe was forged in defiance and strikes with relentless fury.

name: Drak Whistle Bow
description: This bow was fashioned after the likeness of the Drak'Dal, even though they don't use such weapons themselves. An arrow shot from this bow will split the air like the sharp whistle of the drakian tongue.

name: Jagged Obsidian Axe
description: A savage weapon of black glass. The blade seems almost alive, dark as the void and sharp as Drak scales.

name: Rattlesnake Bow
description: The bow curves into a zig-zag shape on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.

name: Sharktooth Greatsword
description: The edges of this blade are indented and therefore resemble cuts made by razor-sharp fins or rows of shark teeth.

name: Violet Storm
description: Spikes disrupt the smooth surface and jut forward like razor blades. They spring from within a center of calm, from the storm's eye, as devastating violet rain on a thunderous night — after which all weakness will be cleansed, and only the strongest may rise from the submerged lands. According to folklore, this symbolizes the origin of the drakian Broodmother Vesztah. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Massive Hammer
description: A large hammer, made from a combination of rock and steel. The mix of materials makes it especially heavy.

name: Vesztah's Mace
description: Two mirrored Drak are represented on this mace. Despite being outwardly similar, they may not share the same fate — for the Broodmother's duality demands the weak become a feast for the strong.

name: Hammer Of The Piercing Gaze
description: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.

name: Abyssal Wing Axe
description: The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.

name: Graven Idol Axe
description: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.

name: Skull Splitter Axe
description: The Skull Splitter gets its name from its merciless nature — cleaving skulls with every swing.

name: Totempole Mace
description: A mace with a segmented body, reminiscent of a totem pole climbing towards the sky. The head is augmented with a stone crown that radiates outwards.

name: Totemhead Mace
description: A ghastly visage is carved into the mace, looking down on your foes as you smash them into the ground.

name: Drak'Dal Spine
description: Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.

name: Spine Of Dalszul
description: Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator — hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.

name: Recent Drak Wand
description: A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Ancient Drak Wand
description: A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Tomb Raider's Bow
description:
A standard, carved bow that reminds you of forgotten temples and overgrown tombs. Makes you want to go exploring for hidden riches!

Grave robbing is bad, and you shouldn't do it while anyone is looking.

name: Temple Keeper's Bow
description: Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them — to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.

name: Shellbreaker Daggers
description: Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Broodmother’s Eye
description: These Daggers are adorned with crystal inlays shaped like eyes, a constant reminder to their wielders that the Broodmother Vesztah watches them at all times. It is believed that she guides their hand — ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Blood Omen Axe
description: This colossal axe draws strength from those it wounds, stealing their vitality with each strike.

name: Curse Bringer Axe
description: Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.

name: Spiked Greatsword
description: Every rose has thorns — and sometimes, nature can serve as inspiration for weaponry and design!

name: Horned Greatsword
description: Sharp extensions jut out from the blade's periphery: an assortment of stingers, sharpened flint, and horns. A strike from this jagged edge will rip and tear almost anything.

name: Tribal Hammer
description: A common hammer that may have once been used by ancient Drak'Dal tribe members. Its simple design speaks to its utilitarian nature.

name: Chieftain's Hammer
description: An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.

name: Staff Of Reeds
description: The mandibles of the staff open towards the skies like a snapjaw's maw, looking to drag prey down to the depths of the moor... Powerful magic cast through this weapon can damn anyone to darkness. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff Of The Moor
description: A sublime staff that carries an eerie visage and blank stare. Its face seems as if it were looking up at you from beneath the motionless surface of a black moor. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Lucent Axe
description: The light it bears is a small comfort amidst the sea of sorrow. A lonely star, a guiding light moving frantically against the black skies.

name: Androme's Wand
description: "My dear students, I depart once more... but do not fret! I've prepared a task — and a wand to help you solve it — for my absence! Use this tool to trace the constellations in the sky. Can you find the sign of the Pheonix?" - Professor Androme Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Stellar Wand
description: A wand with a certain celestial quality. It captures the light of the stars above, similarly to a telescope. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Starborn Sword
description: A sword that was forged on a faraway star. Its light is now dormant, but not entirely lost.

name: Solstice Daggers
description: They unveil their true power during the solstice, as if they were recharged and invigorated by the sun's rays. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Daggers Of Liquid Light
description: The blades thicken and slim periodically in subtle waves, as if they were forged from pure, liquid light. Be careful not to blind yourself when wielding these in battle! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Luminary Staff
description: A staff that reigns with superior intellectual prowess, ingenuity, and near-boundless energy. It can only be wielded by the brightest minds of our time — or those who deem themselves such. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Ezramin's Courage
description: "It's not right to leave humanity behind. Their world is ours. I feel, no, I know that this is my home. Stars be damned — Let's fight for Embervale!" - Ezramin

name: Manathor's Greatsword
description: "Embervale is nothing but a speck of dust; a single point in time from which we will propel ourselves forward. We'll leap from here, into the future — towards the stars above. Towards home. No matter where we land... we will make our mark. They will remember us. They will remember me." - Manathor

name: Starry Seedrattle
description: A mace with a cosmic design on it. It rattles as you swing it, as it's filled with an assortment of dried, Ancient seeds.

name: Axe Of Deimos
description: An axe named after a small moon that orbits a red planet, tirelessly drifting through the void... somewhere far, far away from the valleys you call home.

name: Bow Of The Twin Moons
description: The decorative orbs attached to the bow's body light up and darken in sync. Always together, chained to an otherworldly rhythm, an ebb and flow from beyond.

name: Nocturnal Axe
description: Forged from a dark metal, mysterious and silent as the night. This axe does not reflect, does not allow light. Still, you believe you catch reflections dancing across the blade from the corner of your eye... surely, your sight betrays you.

name: Lunar Tides Bow
description: The upper and lower limbs of the bow curve inwards gracefully, creating the shape of symmetrical waves coming to a crash as the shot is fired. May the crescent illuminate your arrows and steady your breath.

name: Lorekeeper's Greatsword
description: A large greatsword with a subtle circle pattern. You get the feeling that each curve could resemble a syllable, interlocking where they rhyme to create poetry... however, you could not possibly ascertain meaning from the symbols.

name: Eldermere's Staff
description: "A staff of my own design. The dome that encapsulates the tip can contain highly concentrated bolts of energy before releasing them into the spell of my choosing. The quilted leather along the hilt adds a refined touch, I believe." - Eldermere, Chief Engineer Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Constantio's Constructeer, V1.0
description: A construction hammer used by the Ancients to create their multi-purpose constructs. It was created to be incredibly lightweight to reduce the breaks workers would initiate from tired arms.

name: Claravinta's Seedling Swinger
description: "This simple mace hides something fantastic inside — a plethora of seeds that will help war-ridden lands recover faster after battle! With this, we'll nurture the flora of the future while defending the present! I've opted for sustainable wheat, nutritious bell peppers, and beautiful cornflowers... in a breathtaking hue of my own design." - Elder Claravinta

name: Constantio's Constructeer, V2.0
description: "A new and improved version of the Constructeer V1.0! This model is lighter, faster, more precise, and all-around better! See the delicate lines I've added to the sides? They swing as if bound by gravitational pull — a reminder that time never stands still, and neither should we! Let's move forward into a new era together!" - Artificer Constantio

name: Axe Of Phobos
description: You feel as though the axe creates a rift, a tear in the air with each swing. You peer through to see the nothingness, the vast expanse, the blackness far above. Who reigns in the sea of stars? Perhaps loneliness. Or fear.

name: Calescent Axe
description: It burns the palms when wielded without caution, leaving blisters and pain even as the heat of battle fades.

name: Molten Axe
description: It feels as though this metal, still carrying a small flame as its eye, like a candle's light, never truly solidified. The axe's body still bends and morphs under your touch, eager to be molded by your grip.

name: Solar Mace
description: A mace with a spiked head shaped like a blazing sun. When raised high, following the curvature of your swing, the sun reaches its zenith — willing and able to blare down at its opponents with full power.

name: Sunset Mace
description: Its top is nearly entirely flat, its horizontal line only broken by the protruding rays of a setting sun. Pieces of cloth drape to either side, swaying in the wind like banners of an old reign.

name: Bright Hope Sword
description: An iron blade erupts from the golden handle, splitting it like a growing sprig leaping through gilded leaves. Hope always finds a way to grow, even in the darkest of times.

name: Pyreheart Blade
description: The blade near the handle is segmented into three shapes, which form an upside-down heart when viewed as a whole. It carries a vermilion gemstone inside that burns bright as a pyre.

name: Ashwood Wand
description: A wand that burns with the same destructive force that has razed villages, libraries, and museums. Artefacts and tomes, burnt to a crisp and falling to dust... can you wield this power responsibly? Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Candlelight Wand
description: It burns softly, just enough to brighten the dark hallways of forgotten archives. Riddles with lost answers, poems with rhymes that flutter and flee, and stories of unwritten ends reveal themselves before you. Keep their memory alive. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Firefeather Bow
description: A formidable bow that ignites foes from afar. It bears crimson fangs that jut from its centre and carries diamond-shaped appendages along its body. It reminds you of a bloodsucking bat or a fiery bird with a fearsome beak.

name: Phoenix Bow
description: An asymmetrical bow that's headed by a golden phoenix. The drawstring is reinforced with yellow diamonds that reflect the light with every little movement.

name: Astral Daggers
description: A quick set of daggers that reflects the light of the stars above. The handle is topped by an elliptical guard that appears to be floating. It reminds one of planetary rings. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Ascendant Daggers
description: A prideful set of daggers. They foretell a path through the galaxy, enabling the wielder to rise and slash their mark into a star-dotted sky. 3 golden rings mark the handle's beginning and end. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Magmatic Axe
description: An axe that's hot to the touch, as it was forged inside an active volcano. It's ready to unleash fiery chaos with every swing.

name: Firebird's Claw
description: An axe that has risen from the ashes of a dead world, now soaring high above the ground. Once you sink your claws into a foe with this weapon, they'll soon turn to dust to nourish the Earth anew.

name: Greatsword Of Embers
description: A luminous greatsword that reaches towards the sun above like a rekindled fire. It slashes through the night with vigor, creating light in the dark.

name: Greatsword Of The Motherflame
description: An honorable greatsword that resembles the Motherflame herself. Wield it with passion — and caution. Carrying this sword binds one to duty!

name: The Henchman
description: Those who wield this hammer do whatever it takes to be on the right side of history — that being the winning side.

name: The Hennihilator
description: Your eyes do not betray you: This weapon is essentially a chicken on a stick. However, it is incredibly fearsome, and therefore, you'd do well not to draw its ire! Those who anger the Hennihilator do not live to tell the tale!

name: Ony's Staff
description: A sequence of words is etched along the handle. They feel vaguely familiar to you. I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Dragoncore Staff
description: A blood-red gem hovers above the staff, exposed and splintered. The era of dragons has long passed. One day, the Dawn Age, the age of mankind, will end, too. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Rough Sandstone Block
description: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.

name: Regular Sandstone Block
description: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost-efficient.

name: Rough Stone Block
description: A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Rough Wood Block
description: A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Tarred Shingle Roof Block
description: Tarring the Wood Logs makes them more resistant and perfect for rooftops. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Plant Fiber Roof Block
description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Regular Stone Block
description: A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.

name: Refined Wood Block
description: Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.

name: Refined Stone Block
description: A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.

name: Tarred Wood Block
description: A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Tarred Straw Block
description: Made from straw and enhanced with tar. This is an enhanced version of the Plant Fiber Roof Block, especially well-suited to protecting against the elements.

name: Fired Bricks Block
description: A block made of Fired Bricks. It has a dull red color.

name: Roof Tiles Block
description: A Roof Tiles Block is needed to build shingle roofs, commonly seen in construction.

name: Weathered Stone Block
description: In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.

name: Well Block
description: Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.

name: Refined Sandstone Block
description: A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.

name: Highly Polished Stone Block
description: A stone block refined with the highest level of craftsmanship, rarely seen even in ancient times.

name: Desert Temple Block
description: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.

name: Roughly Cut Stone Block
description: A block made out of rocks extracted from the ground. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation! Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Half-Timbered Block
description: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.

name: Citywall Block
description: A neglected building material which is often used to building high and sturdy walls. This block protected the denizens of many cities before the fall.

name: Limestone Block
description: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.

name: Fancy Stone Block
description: This is no normal stone block. It comes with wooden decorations. Floors or ceilings built with this block are covered with wooden planks, and windows or doors get a wooden frame too.

name: Palm Wood Block
description: Perfect to build a provisional house in hot areas. Palm wood is a great alternative to conventional wood, mimicking its charm and durability.

name: Desert City Wall
description: Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.

name: Castle Wall Stone Block
description: A washed version of the Rough Stone Block. Exposed to the weather, the stones have lost their rough features over time.

name: Mycelium Overgrown Block
description: A block of stone infested by Shroud spores. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Shroud Wood Block
description: A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Rough Flintstone Block
description: These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Blue Luminescent Block
description: A block crafted from Luminous Growth material that glows in the dark. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Straw Roof Block
description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to protect yourself from the elements.

name: Iron Block
description: Iron Blocks are incredibly reliable and add a decorative edge to any building.

name: Copper Block
description: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.

name: Bronze Block
description: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.

name: Metal Block
description: Use Metal Blocks to add decorative elements to your buildings. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Stone Shingle Roof Block
description: A natural way to decorate a roof. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Bone Block
description: A block made from pale ribs and cranial bone. Its ivory guise decorates tombs and temples alike. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Red Marble Block
description: This block, made from polished red marble fragments, has a mysterious yet graceful look.

name: Hollow Halls Block
description: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Ectoplasm Block
description: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.

name: Green Luminescent Block
description: A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: White Luminescent Block
description: A building block crafted from White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

name: Temple Stones
description: Weathered stones, either built or claimed by the Vukah. The yellow-tinged moss in the furrows hints at its age.

name: Brick-Timbered Block
description: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.

name: Plaited Block
description: A building block made from tightly woven twigs. It's used inside Vukah buildings.

name: Conifer Wood Block
description: A cozy, darker wood block made from conifer logs. It makes you want to hunt in the mountains or to drink hot tea by the fire.

name: Granite Block
description: A stone building block made with granite. The many minerals inside give it a special, speckled look.

name: Polished Granite Block
description: A highly polished version of the granite wall block. Possible imperfections were largely removed, creating a more seamless finish.

name: Granite Shingle Roof Block
description: These granite shingles bring a mountain flair to your cozy homestead.

name: Granite Ornamented Roof Block
description: You can fashion a beautifully detailed, dark roof with this granite roof block.

name: Obsidian Block
description: A pitch-black block of solid obsidian. Building with this will add a mystical aura to your home!

name: Yellow Luminescent Block
description: A phosphorizing yellow block that draws your eyes in with whispered promises of wealth and secrecy.

name: Midnight Tomb Block
description: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.

name: Starlight Block
description: A building block brandishing fine, luminous constellations on a midnight blue background, framed by golden panels.

name: Desert Shingle Roof Block
description: A shingle block in blue hues, used in the angled rooftops of the Kindlewastes.

name: Castle Block
description: Only a prestigious castle can be built from such sturdy stone.

name: Drak Temple Block
description: A building block that's commonly used by the Drak, specifically the Drak'Dal.

name: Bamboo Wood Block
description: This building block is made from sustainable materials, specifically bamboo. It has a beachy feel to it.

name: Drak Temple Roof Block
description: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.

name: Palm Leaf Roof Block
description: A breezy roof made from natural materials. It makes you want to take a tropical vacation.

name: Half-timbered Shell Limestone Block
description: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.

name: Shell Limestone Shingles
description: With these sturdy shingles, your house is well protected.

name: Shell Limestone Block
description: This stone block is commonly used in Veilwater Basin.

name: Castle Roof Block
description: With this greenish castle roof block, nothing stands in the way of your architectural masterpieces.

name: Red Carpet Block
description: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.

name: Moonstone Block
description: A solid block of shimmering moonstone. It's cool to the touch and it catches light beautifully.

name: Ancient Beacon Block
description: A glowing block casting a yellow light that's visible across vast distances. The Ancients are believed to have used it for navigation and signaling — though whatever network it was part of has long since fallen silent.

name: Ancient Circles Block
description: A gray building block that's marked by the radial shapes and gold circles traditionally associated with Ancient crafts.

name: Ancient Gold Block
description: A solid gold block from the Ancients, frequently used to adorn structures with decorative trim.

name: Ancient Stone Block
description: The standard and favored building block among the Ancients.

name: Ornate Wood Block
description: An ornate wood building block with intricate details.

name: Weathered Ancient Stone Block
description: This block has an aesthetic that is exclusive to the Blackmire. Only this biome's unique flora and humidity can make Ancient stones weather like this.

name: Ancient Dungeon Block
description: An Ancient block that creates walls with a subtle yet distinct scallop pattern. It is most frequently used inside Ancient Spires.

name: Bronze Key
description: Opens a locked chest.

name: Gold Key
description: Opens doors of great importance.

name: Silver Key
description: Opens most locked doors.

name: Lockpick
description: Opens a lock.

name: Key to The Pike
description: Opens all doors in the "The Pike", the castle within <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>.

name: Revelwood Bone Key
description:
Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

name: Nomad Highlands Bone Key
description:
Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

name: Kindlewastes Bone Key
description:
Opens doors in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

name: Albaneve Summits Bone Key
description:
Opens doors in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

name: Veilwater Basin Bone Key
description:
Opens doors in the Veilwater Basin Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

name: Archaic Lockpick
description: Lockpicks exclusively used by the Ancients in their structures and dungeons.

name: Of Daggers And Wine
description: A music sheet for a dramatic song fit for nights of devilry. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Cup Runneth Over
description: A music sheet for a song to play by the fireplace while telling adventure stories. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: By The Riverside
description: A music sheet for a song that bestows a minor boost in morale. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Fleeting Memory
description: A music sheet for a bright song fit for any lively tavern. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Satin Strings
description: A music sheet for a soft song with heavenly tones. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Moon Over The Well
description: A music sheet for a somber song to play in the moonlight. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Market On A Yearfall's Day
description: This song uses a colorful soundscape to paint a lively market on a cold day. The bright tones illuminate the scenery like fairy lights. It makes you want to warm up with some mead! Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Mirage
description: Music that evokes flaming rays of sunlight, and the burning soles of a 1000-mile walk. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Lonely At The Top
description: A music sheet that contains a thought-provoking tune. Snow falls ever so slowly when pondering the past. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Silent Echo
description: Music that illustrates the awe-inspiring first impression that the imposing mountain range leaves behind. All echoes are swallowed by fresh, pure snow. No one will hear you here. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Blood In The Snow
description: A song inspired by the unforgiving beauty of the North. Whenever fresh blood is spilled, snowflakes dance downwards from the skies to wash away the sanguine stain. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Morning Sun
description: Gaze at the sunlight washing over the mountains, and bathe in the early warmth as you set out on your journey. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Pikemead's Peak
description: The time for glory is now. Bask in its glow. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Child Of The Lyre
description: Somewhere in the kingdom of Orindell, naked feet dance upon hot marble floors. The pain is temporary, but the memory will last. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Flaming Heartbeat
description: Feel the rhythm of life and the heat of battle with this energizing melody. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

name: Mae's Map Piece
description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms

name: Polaris' Map Piece
description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

name: Orpheus' Map Piece
description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

name: Ony's Map Piece
description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

name: The Dragons' Map
description: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

description: Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster. It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Chain Lightning III
description: Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Shock Wisp II
description: Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Protective Barrier
description: Conjures a magical shield that blocks and absorbs incoming projectiles until its health is depleted. You and your allies also gain 25% increased Physical Resistance within the barrier. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Shroud Beam
description: Releases an aimed ray of disastrous Shroud that continuously deals damage to enemies within. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Shroud Meteor
description: Calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Exploding Arrow IV
description: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with immense firepower.

name: Celestium Arrow
description: The Celestium tip shimmers beautifully in the sun. But don't let that distract you from landing a precise shot.

name: Poisoned Celestium Arrow
description: A Celestium Special Arrow dipped in poison. Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 30 damage per second for 5 seconds.

name: Moonstone Arrow
description: An arrow with a precisely polished moonstone tip.

name: Shroud Arrow III
description: If you can't beat them, join them. This Special Arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.

name: Eternal Frost Arrow III
description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's ice-cold to the touch. Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

name: Blunt Arrow
description: A devastating arrow with a blunt tip. It's bound to unleash a ton of force on impact.

name: Eternal Heal Beam II
description: Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Mana Drain VIII
description: Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

name: Eternal Entangle
description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Blizzard II
description: Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Ice Totem II
description: Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Pillar Of Flames I
description: Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within. It also applies a burn debuff to them. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Fire Totem II
description: Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Shock Totem
description: Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Ball Lightning I
description: Conjures a slow moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles. It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Hollow Wretch II
description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Heal Cascade II
description: Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

name: Ice Bolt IV
description: Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Fireball IV
description: Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Chain Lightning II
description: Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Fire Bolt VIII
description: Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Bonestorm II
description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

name: Eternal Giant Bone Arrow II
description: An eternal bone arrow that's overgrown with green crystals. Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

name: Eternal Voltaic Arrow III
description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity. Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

name: Eternal Ember Arrow III
description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot. Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

name: Axe
description: A primitive tool used for cutting wood. It can also be used as a weapon in a pinch.

name: Grappling Hook
description: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.

name: Glider
description: The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait. Press %k whilst in the air to open the Glider. Using the wind currents and the height of the starting point, it can be used to travel great distances in an instant.

name: Torch
description: This basic torch provides light for a short amount of time. Watch your step when exploring caves with this!

name: Scrappy Axe
description: An axe made out of scrap metal with improved durability and efficiency compared to the Axe.

name: Rake
description: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.

name: Advanced Rake
description: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.

name: Resin Torch
description: An advanced torch that provides light for a longer period. Use this to explore deeper into the abyss!

name: Wax Torch
description: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!

name: Scrappy Pickaxe
description: Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.

name: Copper Pickaxe
description: A decent tool forged out of copper. At least working does not become a hassle because of bad equipment.

name: Bronze Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.

name: Copper Axe
description: A sharp copper axe which is highly efficient at cutting wood. It can also be used to cut down enemies.

name: Iron Pickaxe
description: A highly performant pickaxe made out of iron, useful in every environment. A truly handy tool to have.

name: Advanced Glider
description: This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.

name: Extraordinary Glider
description: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.

name: Ghost Glider
description: A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.

name: Improved Grappling Hook
description: Requires less stamina. Can be activated at larger ranges.

name: Bronze Axe
description: An Axe with a bronze head. Sturdier than the Copper version.

name: Iron Axe
description: An axe with a very sturdy iron head. It's more efficient!

name: Pickaxe
description: A basic mining tool, made of the simplest of materials. It's not very durable or efficient, but it does what it's supposed to.

name: Steel Pickaxe
description: This pickaxe can help you dig deeper and further due to the pick having been forged from steel. Heave ho!

name: Steel Axe
description: This improved tool will lose durability more slowly thanks to its steel cutting blade. Be careful with your fingers while woodworking!

name: Gleam Root Diving Light
description: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.

name: Mining Sieve
description: A hand scraper and sieve that can be used to mine gold and other materials underwater.

name: Portable Water Pump
description: A tool that allows you to add and remove water in your base. It can also be utilized for irrigation and applying the Wet or Soaked Debuff to enemies. Fill it with water from a well or lake before beginning operation. Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

name: Watering Can
description: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.

name: Underwater Grappling Hook
description: A grappling hook that can be used underwater.

name: Gilded Pickaxe
description: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.

name: Gilded Axe
description: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.

name: Water Pouch
description: This pouch can be filled at a well or lake. A sip of water helps to recharge your power!

name: Camera
description: You can take screenshots with this item.

name: Celestium Axe
description: An axe forged from basalt stone and celestium. The most durable of its kind.

name: Celestium Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from basalt stone and celestium. The most durable of its kind.

name: Penny Bun
description:
A great snack that stimulates the brain.

Increases your magic damage by a small amount.

name: Honey
description: The following sugar rush recharges stamina!

name: Grilled Lean Meat
description:
Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack.

Increases health of the user by a small margin.

name: Raw Lean Meat
description: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.

name: Water
description: A refreshing bottle of Water that grants more Stamina. Stay hydrated.

name: Purple Berries
description: Tasty and fresh berries, stimulating the bodily regeneration abilities with fresh vitamins for a short duration.

name: Grilled Wolf Meat
description: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, providing a substantial amount of health to the consumer.

name: Raw Wolf Meat
description: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.

name: Grilled Penny Bun
description: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.

name: Corncob
description: A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled, or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.

name: Aureolin Flower
description: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.

name: Dried Purple Berry
description: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple Berries. However, the duration lasts longer.

name: Roasted Corncob
description: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.

name: Tomato
description: A red and juicy Tomato! If handled with care, it can have enhancing effects.

name: Milk
description: A delicious jug of milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and recharge your stamina faster!

name: Midnight Lily
description: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.

name: Meat and Corncob Skewer
description: With just some meat, a corncob, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

name: Meat and Mushroom Skewer
description: It’s a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

name: Meat and Tomato Skewer
description: Even in the simplest setting, this skewer comes together easily with meat, a tomato, and a small flame.

name: Raw Game
description: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.

name: Roasted Azure Russula
description: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.

name: Grilled Game
description: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.

name: Strawberry
description: A delicious aggregate-accessory fruit, predominantly found in the Revelwood.

name: Vegetable Puree
description: Cooking is a delicate art form. This basic puree will aid any person on their way to becoming an exquisite chef.

name: Chamomile Tea
description: A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.

name: Azure Russula
description: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.

name: Hazelnut
description: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.

name: Stinging Nettle
description: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.

name: Forest Beet
description: A root brimming with energy, but not very effective in its raw form. Improves the Dexterity of the consumer.

name: Ectoplasm Soup
description: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.

name: Cooked Fae Deer Milk
description: A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!

name: Uncooked Fae Deer Milk
description: Raw Fae Deer milk. It has to be cooked to be consumed safely.

name: Gloomberry
description: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue color pigments.

name: Tomato Fish Soup
description: A creamy and delectable tomato soup, made more aromatic with a fish filet.

name: Popcorn
description: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.

name: Meat and Forest Beet Skewer
description: With just some meat, a forest beet, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

name: Meat and Hazelnut Skewer
description: With just some meat, a hazelnut, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

name: Meat and Azure Russula Skewer
description: It’s a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

name: Raw Bird Meat
description: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

name: Grilled Bird Meat
description: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect...

name: Rooibos Tea
description: An aromatic ingredient that calms the body, providing an instant boost of Stamina for the user.

name: Flat Bread
description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

name: Boiled Eggs
description: Simple but nourishing. Boosts Health and Stamina Regeneration.

name: Eggs
description: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.

name: Mushroom Omelette
description: A delicious meal with an earthy taste.

name: Chicken Soup
description: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness.

name: Sugar Cane
description: A sweet candy alternative made from plant fiber. The sugar rush is known to regenerate stamina for a short amount of time.

name: Sage Leaves
description: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: A warm soup made from various vegetables. Full of vitamins and energy.

name: Bell Pepper
description: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.

name: Sugar
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Greater Ectoplasm Soup
description: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.

name: Purple Berry Cake
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Calla Luna Soup
description: A soup made from various vegetables and calla luna flowers. It glows in the dark and extends your Time in the Shroud!

name: Buttermilk
description: A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it's very refreshing.

name: Butter
description: Creamy butter with milky richness — perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.

name: Spiced Tea
description: Hot and spicy! Surprisingly refreshing and cooling even in the heat.

name: Fruit Bowl
description:
A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

Boosts health and stamina upon consumption.

name: Open Sandwich
description: A relatively simple, but fortifying meal. Fast and ready to go!

name: Glow Soup
description: A weird brew emitting a blue glow... Nobody quite knows why.

name: Raw Dune Armadillo Meat
description: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.

name: Grapple Plant
description: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.

name: Meat Wrap
description: Filled with the power of life, this wrap will increase the Health of the consumer.

name: Grilled Yucca Fruit
description: When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.

name: Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: A healthy mix of vegetables. When eaten with care, it will fill both your stomach and heart.

name: Yucca Fruit
description: A sweet fruit that grows in dry areas, needing little water. Despite that, it's quite refreshing!

name: Grilled Dune Armadillo
description: A specialty of the Kindlewastes — customers love it because of its health benefits!

name: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup
description: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit... fermented.

name: Strawberry Cake
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Shadowbloom Wrap
description: This wrap is a good alternative to the more commonly seen meat wrap. It still increases your health, and additionally, the shadowbloom stocks are very filling and extend your Time in the Shroud.

name: Fish Chowder
description: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.

name: Date
description: Sweet, sticky fruits of the date palm. Travelers swear by them for a quick recovery on the road.

name: Strawberry Milkshake
description: A delightful milkshake. Be careful with the sugar rush! It will regenerate your health and stamina.

name: Gentian
description: A star-shaped blossom that blooms in the high-up mountains. It grants more mana when consumed.

name: Grilled Fatty Meat
description: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!

name: Raw Fatty Meat
description: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.

name: Beef Stew
description: A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.

name: Herbal Mountain Tea
description: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.

name: Yellow Glow Soup
description: It tastes a bit bitter, but is known to increase mana, mana regeneration and magic damage. What a magical soup!

name: Frizzy Goat Milk
description: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and stamina regeneration.

name: Chanterelle
description: It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.

name: Pumpkin Soup
description: A tasty pumpkin soup. It's creamy and rich in flavor. It will also keep you warm. What's not to love?

name: Glimmer Gentian Tea
description: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the Shroud.

name: Pumpkin
description: Pumpkins are beloved for their sweet, earthy flavor in cooking and their sturdy, hollow shells for festive crafts.

name: Creamy Mushroom Spaetzle
description: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.

name: Exceptional Ectoplasm Soup
description: It contains ice and gentian — a failed attempt at herbal iced tea? Its strengths certainly do not lie in its taste.

name: Goat Food Bait
description:
Food for attracting and taming a goat. It can be given to both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

description:
