name: Cooked Rice
description: This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.

name: Banana
description: A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.

name: Plantain
description: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.

name: Algae
description: These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.

name: Raw Taro
description: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.

name: Ginger
description: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.

name: Coconut
description: A fresh coconut, plucked directly from a palm tree. The water inside can be drunk as is or processed into milk.

name: Coconut Milk
description: This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.

name: Taro Root Curry
description: A scrumptious curry with lots of heat and depth of flavor. It will make you feel warm and cozy!

name: Ginger Tea
description: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.

name: Algae Salad
description: An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.

name: Fried Rice
description: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!

name: Plantain Curry
description: A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.

name: Honey Baked Banana
description: The banana and honey combine to create a smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!

name: Coconana Smoothie
description: A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.

name: Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice
description: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!

name: Fish Cutlet
description: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the bones, but you can still enjoy it.

name: Fish Filet
description: The Filet from an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.

name: Dried Banana Chips
description: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer — and the crunch is nice, too.

name: Crab Meat
description: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.

name: Grilled Crab Meat
description: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!

name: Candied Ginger
description: Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch — this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.

name: Sushi
description: Fresh, healthy, fun to eat, and good for the soul. What more could you want from a meal?

name: Crab Cakes
description: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.

name: Algae Buds
description: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.

name: Grilled Algae Buds
description: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!

name: Shiitake Mushroom
description: Shiitake mushrooms work wonders for deepening the flavor of any dish.

name: Roasted Shiitake Mushroom
description: A roasted shiitake mushroom. The new, smoky aftertaste brings out the umami flavor.

name: Seared Fish Filet
description: Seared on the grill to perfection, enjoy this exquisite piece of fish filet.

name: Seared Fish Cutlet
description: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavorful.

name: Black Coffee
description: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?

name: Latte
description: Coffee that's been refined with a splash of milk. The mild aroma makes it easy to sip!

name: Sweet Mokka
description: A traditionally brewed cup of coffee with a hint of sugar. The sweetness pairs well with the depth of flavor.

name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm Soup
description: A thick, viscous soup made from volatile extoplasm. It tastes vaguely minty.

name: Shadowtail
caption: Fish
description:
This is a rare, midnight-black variant of the Stripetail. Its dark scales absorb light, making it nearly invisible underwater. This patient predator strikes from the depths when you least expect it.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Emberfin
caption: Fish
description:
This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Yellowfin
caption: Fish
description:
A sleek fish with a vivid yellow fin, also known for its quick bursts of speed.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Grilled Lakehopper
description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

name: Silverback
caption: Fish
description:
This sleek, silver-scaled fish is known for the distinctive metallic sheen along its back, which gives it its name.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Shimmerfin
caption: Fish
description:
Despite wearing black bands over their eyes like bandits, they are relatively easy to catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Grilled Shimmerfin
description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

name: Lakehopper
caption: Fish
description:
The Lakehopper is an agile fish that you might see "hopping" across the surface of a shallow lake — if you're lucky.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Sunscale
caption: Fish
description:
The Sunscale's name is derived from the distinctive shimmer of its scales, which catch the sunlight.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Waveleaper
caption: Fish
description:
The Waveleaper dances atop the waves with unmatched agility, a living embodiment of the waters untamed spirit.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Grilled Silverback
description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

name: Stripetail
caption: Fish
description:
A slender fish, recognizable by its distinctive black stripes running along its body.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Shockfin
caption: Fish
description:
Said to be born from lightning striking open water, the Shockfin is charged with electric energy. Be careful when trying to pull it out of the water.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Thornridge
caption: Fish
description:
As its distinctive appearance suggests, the Thornridge is an epic fish that only a very skilled fisher can catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Crimsonback
caption: Fish
description:
The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

name: Whiskerfin
caption: Fish
description:
This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait, too.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.

name: Prickle Pearl
description: An ancient crossbreed that reminds you of a pomegranate or a fig that started to sprout — but the whiskers tickle conspicuously in the throat.

name: Aurora Beans
description: Colored like the first light of morning, these bean-like structures grow straight from the blossom. The color alone is hard to explain — the taste even more so. They need to be cooked before eating.

name: Grandleaf Cabbage
description: The gigantic leaves of this plant are as useful as they are gorgeous. They taste something like cabbage — ideal thinly sliced in a salad, or used as a wrap.

name: Bloomheart Fruit
description: The Bloomheart Fruit takes it's time to ripen, but when it's ready something so juicy and sweet awaits you. It's worth the patience.

name: Thyme
description: Small leaves with a strong presence. A little goes a long way, perfect for a fine fresh tea!

name: Aurora Bean Rice
description: A colorful dish of rice, beans, and fresh vegetables. As nourishing as it is beautiful.

name: Plantain Salad with Aurora Beans
description: A hearty salad of cooked and roasted plantains, chopped vegetables, and aurora beans. Simple ingredients, satisfying results.

name: Grandleaf Cabbage Rolls
description: Hearty cabbage rolls made from the broad leaves of the ancient Grandleaf Cabbage, filled with seasoned meat.

name: Cabbage Mushroom Rice
description: A simple pan-fried dish of chopped cabbage, mushrooms, and tomatoes served over rice.

name: Exotic Fruit Salad
description: A vibrant mix of Prickle Pearl, Bloomheart Fruit, Strawberries, and Dates. Sweet, exotic, and refreshingly simple.

name: Prickle Pearl Tart
description: A buttery shortcrust pastry tart filled with fresh Prickle Pearls. Delicate and sweet with that unmistakable tickle on the tongue.

name: Thyme Tea
description: Freshly brewed tea steeped from hand-picked thyme. So simple and aromatic.

name: Pearlbloom Nectar
description: A refined nectar pressed from Prickle Pearl and Bloomheart Fruit. It tingles on the tongue before settling into a smooth, soothing sweetness.

name: Fish Tacos
description: Crispy fish tacos filled with a hearty plantain rice.

name: <craftingstation>Workbench</craftingstation>
description:
Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment. 

The <craftingstation>Workbench</craftingstation> can only be placed inside the area of a Flame Altar.

name: Campfire
description: A small campfire to cook food that can give many bonuses. It's a great spot to take a rest and relax.

name: Decoration Workbench
description: Equipped with woodworking and stone masonry tools, this workbench lets you craft beautiful decorative pieces for your home with the Carpenter’s help.

name: Kitchen
description: With the farmer’s guidance, you can prepare refined meals at this kitchen station.

name: Ancient Workbench
description:
Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment. 

The <craftingstation>Workbench</craftingstation> can only be placed inside the area of a Flame Altar.

This Ancient Workbench is only a visual variation of the normal workbench.

name: Sparkworks Workbench
description: The Sparkworks Workbench allows you to craft multiple logic tools like levers or light switches that can be edited with the Sparkworks Tool.

name: Incendiary Ball
description:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Lute
description: Lutes are a classic instrument of choice for bards. They can be used to play beautiful melodies with friends or alone.

name: Flute
description: A flute carved from bone. You can use it to make music.

name: Hand Drum
description: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.

name: Harp
description: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.

name: Ornate Hand Drum
description:
A fine drum with a patterned leather cover, famously owned by Daniel the Damned, a former member of the Honeydews. Fans speculated that the back of the drum was inscribed with runes that would make Daniel play faster, like a possessed man.

Now that you're holding it, those rumors prove to be false — but his damnation was very real, at least!

name: Exceptional Hand Drum
description: An epic drum with finely painted blue lines on it. The pattern on top resembles a symmetrical star.

name: Exceptional Flute
description: A delicate flute, decorated with swift aquamarine brushstrokes that carry the tones forth like silvery winds.

name: Ornate Flute
description: Miles Rapore's old flute, used to decorate the soundscapes of The Honeydews' many musical performances. He's often credited with keeping the band together, but his reclusive attitude towards crowds and stringent focus on marketability earned him a bad reputation.

name: Exceptional Harp
description: An outstanding harp with fine, silvery strings. The shape of the body and lightweight wood make this instrument perfect for learning to play the strings. Holding it makes you feel a bit melancholic.

name: Ornate Harp
description: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of The Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.

name: Exceptional Lute
description: A wonderful lute with carefully placed, playful decorative lines. They spring forth like joyful melodies on a sunny midyear day.

name: Ornate Lute
description: An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of The Honeydews — the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The Lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftsmanship of the instrument are well preserved.

name: Handpan
description: A hang drum is a hand-played steel instrument whose gentle tones spread like ripples across still water.

name: Exceptional Handpan
description: This golden handpan was used by the Drak. Did they play it during ceremonies, sacrifices, or duels? You can't say for sure, but you do know that its sound is magical and enticing.

name: Ornate Handpan
description: This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.

name: Small Backpack
description: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row. Outdated This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.

name: Ring of Endless Life
description: Created in the pursuit of immortality, it cost countless lives and promises more to follow.

name: Ring of the Flame

name: Alchemist's Ring
description:
A ring with glowing engravings that read: 

"May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"

name: Ring of Rivulets
description: It refreshes your body with the intensity of a cold spring washing over you, letting energy flow through your veins like water in a river. The blue gems adorning this ring resemble lakes.

name: Ring of Frost
description: It hugs your finger like an icy embrace and lets you become one with the cold. It imbues the wearer with increased frost resistance.

name: Ring of Thundersnow
description:
Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. 
The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.

name: Ultimate Ring of Health
description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

name: Ultimate Ring of Mana

name: Ultimate Ring of Stamina
description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

name: Ring of the Heir
description: A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.

name: Ancient Ring of Health
description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

name: Ring of the Mother Flame
description: A golden band that contains a blood-red gem; filigree lapping up around it like flames. The design was inspired by the great altar of the Mother Flame.

name: Ring of the Ancients
description: A broad ring that invokes power through golden glyphs. Spherical discs and tori orbit a central gem, like planetary rings, as the stone in their midst shimmers with unknown colors.

name: Ring of the Ether
description: A strange ring that seems to hold an entire, nebulous world in the stone that adorns it.

name: Gemini Ring
description: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini — quivering with hatred in the moonlight.

name: Commander's Ring
description: A simple and sturdy ring, decorated with three gemstones. The engraving reads: "To <lorename>Cyrus</lorename>, my most loyal Commander and friend". It was found inside the maw of the creature that haunts The Pike.

name: Mother's Eye
description: Silvery like the sea glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.

name: Ring of Rapacity
description: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.

name: Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard
description: "<lorename>Captain Arkwright</lorename>" is engraved in the metal. Given to the most loyal commanders.

name: Noble Gloves
description: These lightweight gloves are perfect for holding a quill and signing decrees.

name: Noble Dress
description: A long, flowing garment. The lower seam effortlessly hovers around the ankles while you walk.

name: Noble Pants
description: These sleek trousers are usually worn underneath more lavish dresses or tunics.

name: Noble Boots
description: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.

name: Noble Diadem
description: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.

name: Explorer Gloves
description: Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

name: Explorer Coat
description: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

name: Explorer Boots
description: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

name: Explorer Helmet
description: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

name: Explorer Pants
description: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

name: Royal Doublet
description: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.

name: Royal Gloves
description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

name: Royal Boots
description: Stomp out anti-feudalist uprisings in style with these fashionable and finely crafted shoes!

name: Royal Pants
description: Billowy pants that were made from the finest silks. They create an interesting and lavish silhouette.

name: Royal Crown
description: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

name: Minstrel Hat
description: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.

name: Trader Hat
description: A merchant's hat that will draw attention in the market square when paired with A LOUD ENOUGH VOICE and good deals!

name: Jester Hat
description: A gleeful and jingly hat. The little bells make frolicking around more joyous.

name: Headscarf
description: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.

name: Tricorn
description: A distinguished hat with a folded-up brim. The front has been embellished with a small metal detail.

name: Cyan Party Hat
description: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

name: Violet Party Hat
description: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

name: Red Party Hat
description: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

name: Yellow Party Hat
description: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

name: Fluffy Tunic
description: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

name: Fluffy Mittens
description: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

name: Fluffy Boots
description: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.

name: Fluffy Pants
description: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

name: Fluffy Hood
description: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

name: Hollow's Eve Chest
description: A dark tunic held together by "fake" bones. They rattle like real ones do. How suspicious!

name: Hollow's Eve Gloves
description: These dark gloves are ideal for going trick or treating!

name: Hollow's Eve Boots
description: You'll make people shake in their boots when you approach in these spooky shoes!

name: Hollow's Eve Pants
description: Spooky pants for spooky fellows!

name: Hollow's Eve Hood
description: A shadowy hood that hides a sinister skull mask underneath. Scary!

name: Serpent Warrior Chest
description: The ruby-red cloth, emerald-colored scales, and golden trim create a warm and regal cosmetic armor piece when combined.

name: Serpent Warrior Gloves
description: The sharp edges of these gloves that stretch towards the wearer's fingertips jot out like viper fangs.

name: Serpent Warrior Boots
description: These boots have an intricate scale pattern on their green plating.

name: Serpent Warrior Pants
description: A pair of grey trousers. They layer well under the more elaborate cloth of the upper body armor.

name: Serpent Warrior Helmet
description: This helmet lets you portray a particularly patient and calculating gaze.

name: Flame Pact Vest
description: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

name: Flame Pact Gloves
description: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!

name: Flame Pact Boots
description: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

name: Flame Pact Pants
description: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

name: Flame Pact Hat
description: A floppy hat with red feathers.

name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak
description: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.

name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Gloves
description: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.

name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots
description: With these boots, the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.

name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants
description: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".

name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet
description: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.

name: Scholar of the Young Flame Cloak
description: A resplendent white-and-gold cloak interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it symbolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.

name: Scholar of the Young Flame Gloves
description: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.

name: Scholar of the Young Flame Boots
description: These golden boots carried the "Scholars of the Young Flame" across the open roads of Embervale. The soles still carry dust from places you have yet to discover.

name: Scholar of the Young Flame Pants
description: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.

name: Scholar of the Young Flame Helmet
description: A radiant headpiece that can be spotted from afar. Not only when the burning sun reflects off of it.

name: Sunny Loungewear Garb
description: A breezy tunic that's perfect for a day by the shore.

name: Sunny Loungewear Boots
description: These simple, comfortable boots are perfect for taking a stroll on a warm summer's day.

name: Sunny Loungewear Pants
description: A pair of lightweight pants. They're simple and easily replaced, so it's not too bad if they become bleached by the sun or drenched with water.

name: Captain's Coat
description: This impressive coat is regal, lived-in, and vaguely... salty. It makes you feel as though you should be steering a ship to safety amidst a thundering storm!

name: Summer Games Headband
description: A sporty headband with gold accents. It matches the set's belt and makes you feel like the ruler of the Summer Games!

name: Summer Games Bangles
description: Asymmetrical bangles that aid viewers in visually differentiating your arm movements as you dash past them towards the finish line.

name: Summer Games Pants
description: The brown trousers possess a reinforced and padded knee area, visible through the applied scale pattern.

name: Summer Games Boots
description: A bandage wrap that lets your takeoff foot achieve maximum jump power. These light coverings make it easier to protect your soles from harm as you prepare to propel yourself through the air!

name: Summer Games Cropped Top
description: An athletic-looking top made from vibrant fabric, held together by leather straps. The cropped cut lets you show off your physique!

name: Siren Seeker Gloves
description: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!

name: Siren Seeker Pants
description: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.

name: Siren Seeker Chest
description: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.

name: Siren Seeker Sandals
description: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.

name: Siren Seeker Headband
description: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.

name: Blood Rose Chestplate
description: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

name: Blood Rose Gloves
description: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such is both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.

name: Blood Rose Boots
description: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.

name: Blood Rose Pants
description: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.

name: Blood Rose Mail Coif
description: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.

name: Exclusive Hollow Chestplate
description: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow, metal trim, and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.

name: Exclusive Hollow Gloves
description: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.

name: Exclusive Hollow Boots
description: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.

name: Exclusive Hollow Pants
description: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

name: Exclusive Hollow Helmet
description: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves
description: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.

name: Efflorescent Hope Chest
description: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

name: Efflorescent Hope Boots
description: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.

name: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown
description:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

name: Efflorescent Hope Pants
description: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

name: Artificer's Helmet
description: A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun — and the beginning of a new era of progress.

name: Artificer's Gloves
description: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.

name: Artificer's Pants
description: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

name: Artificer's Boots
description: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

name: Artificer's Chest
description: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Gloves
description: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Shirt
description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots
description: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood
description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls
description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

name: Mothling Robe
description: This robe was fashioned to look like Emperor Moth wings. The double fur collar is especially soft. Below it lies a macrame shirt, expertly woven by nimble hands.

name: Mothling Gloves
description: Thick wooly gloves. They vaguely smell of bonfires and animal fur. Perhaps someone was wearing these while petting their furry companions by a fire?

name: Mothling Boots
description: Comfortable brown boots that make you feel as if you're being carried on a moth's wings.

name: Mothling Pants
description: Furry boots wrapped with cords. The strands can be unwound to fasten makeshift bandages in a pinch. Decorative pom poms hang dangle from the sides.

name: Mothling Hood
description: A hood with a striking pair of plumose antennae. It keeps you warm and safe while wandering at night, and perhaps the antennae will help you find what you desire — or what you really need.

name: Blacksmith Garb
description: Just enough to protect the wearer from sparks.

name: Blacksmith Hat
description: A simple head-covering to soak up some of that pesky sweat. Keeps your precious ears away from hot swinging irons!

name: Blacksmith Boots
description: These boots will still keep their shape even if you drop a hammer on them. Or tongs. Or an entire anvil. How handy!

name: Blacksmith Pants
description: These pants are smeared with soot.

name: Maid Garb
description: Soft and comfortable maid attire. It's easily cleaned if dirtied with washing water, milk, or wine.

name: Maid Hat
description: A headwrap that's white as snow.

name: Hunter Garb
description: This armor provides perfect protection when venturing out into the forest.

name: Hunter Headband
description: A yellow headband that keeps your hair out of your face when hunting or lumbering.

name: Hunter Boots
description: Makes your step silent and swift.

name: Hunter Pants
description: These belted pants will create a perfect fit no matter if you've had venison or porridge for dinner.

name: Royal Gloves
description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

name: Farmer Garb
description: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.

name: Farmer Hat
description: It keeps the sun out of your tired eyes. That's all it has to do!

name: Farmer Pants
description: Sunbleached pants, carefully patched and sown with leftover thread. The cloth is wearing thin in some areas...

name: Royal Gloves
description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

name: Farmer Boots
description: Simple boots for hardworking folk.

name: Gravedigger Garb
description: These clothes smell of decay.

name: Gravedigger Hat
description: People don't make eye contact with gravediggers because it brings bad luck. Therefore, some graveyard keepers wear a cap that covers their eyes to avoid trouble.

name: Gravedigger Pants
description: There's some extra space in the pockets perfect for storing crypt keys, "borrowed" rings, and lost fingerbones.

name: Royal Gloves
description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

name: Gravedigger Boots
description: Perfect for wading through ash and moldy earth.

name: Milkmaid Garb
description: A grassy green dress for housekeeping or working on the farm.

name: Milkmaid Hat
description: A milky white headwrap that keeps your hair out of your face while working.

name: Milkmaid Boots
description: Simple shoes with flat heels that pair well with dark stockings.

name: Lumberer Hat
description: A hat that is made both practical and fun with added fluffy fur.

name: Lumberer Coat
description: A heavy tunic with fur lining.

name: Lumberer Boots
description: Sturdy boots for gathering wood. They're lined with fur, ideal for the summits.

name: Lumberer Pants
description: Ordinary leather pants.

name: Lumberer Gloves
description: Worn-out gloves with sun spots and a fur trim.

name: Winterly Chest
description: A long furry coat, often worn by the citizens of the Albaneve Summits. It's very cozy.

name: Winterly Gloves
description: A classic pair of gloves. Don't they make you want to throw a snowball?

name: Winterly Boots
description: A pair of comfortable boots perfect for snow days.

name: Winterly Pants
description: A pair of pants with fleece on the inside.

name: Winterly Hat
description: A hat that looks like it protects your precious ears from the cold. It's just cosmetic, though.

name: Loraine's Top
description: Loraine always liked to safekeep the bones she found on excavations personally, as they were too precious to entrust to anyone else.

name: Loraine's Glasses
description: These glasses have seen countless horizons, failures, and successes. You think you can see some faint scratch marks on them — were they caused by vultures?

description: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

description: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

name: Artificer's Boots
description: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

name: Artificer's Helmet
description: A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun — and the beginning of a new era of progress.

name: Artificer's Pants
description: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Gloves
description: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Shirt
description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots
description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood
description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls
description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

name: Vanguard Helmet
description: A rising phoenix thrones above this helmet, protecting your steadfast gaze under its wings. It's a stern reminder of your destiny and the eternity it bears.

name: Vanguard Gloves
description: Scarlet gloves that remind you of all the blood you've shed. Will the battle ever end? You do not know for sure, but today, we shall not dwell on it — for today is for the living.

name: Vanguard Chestplate
description: A golden parade armor that shines brighter than the sun. A resilient flame flickers inside the chestplate's cavity, framed by the sigil which the Flameborn have claimed as their own.

name: Vanguard Boots
description: Gilded boots adorned with fiery, red gemstones. The pattern above the shins bears a resemblance to rays of sunlight or the glory of the blazing Flame.

name: Vanguard Trousers
description: Comfortable pants fashioned from crimson cloth. Being both durable and imposing, they can be worn for parades as well as war.

name: Spellweaver Helmet
description: Magic frames everything you do. Whatever you witness, you see through the lens of the spark — a light that lingers just outside your vision, always peering in from the edges. You serve the Flame. Do so with elegance.

name: Spellweaver Gloves
description: A pair of gloves that enable you to synchronise syllables to spells and weave warding sigils into bulwarks gracefully.

name: Spellweaver Chestplate
description: A lightweight, yet sturdy garnet-colored gambeson. The fire of magic burns inside. It is your duty, Flameborn, to tend to it evermore — for if you perish, the art of sorcery will die with you.

name: Spellweaver Boots
description: Tightly fitted boots, made from gold metal and cured leather. With these, you will be able to dance between the rain of bolts and blades, casting doom upon your foes with swift movements.

name: Spellweaver Pants
description: Lilly-white pants peek through from beneath the crimson coat. It makes you wonder: Can there be innocence in times of war? Despite the bloodshed, the hearts of those who wield magic must always remain pure. Otherwise, their power becomes unbound from both law and morals.

name: Wildheart Hood
description: A hood and mask. The latter reminds you of a bird of prey, ready to descend on its enemies at high noon. Your shadow will be the last they'll ever see.

name: Wildheart Gloves
description: Find the foe's weakness, then aim, breathe, and shoot. Nothing can escape your arrows when the Flame lights their path.

name: Wildheart Chestplate
description: It's a chestplate that has a short, red cape attached to the back. A Flame marks the centre of it, resting where the heart should be. Everything you do, and all you feel, is forever bound to the light of the fire. Let it fill you with pride and warmth.

name: Wildheart Boots
description: A magnificent golden shell for your feet to slip into. With these, you can march with pride — down the streets of your kingdom, through the darkened forest, or into the heart of the Shroud.

name: Wildheart Pants
description: A pair of pants that fills you with a deep sense of duty despite their simplicity.

name: Gem of Bleeding
description: Critical Strikes with Cutting damage cause bleeding on the enemy, dealing %k damage per second for %k.

name: Gem of Puncturing
description: Dealing piercing damage applies puncturing to enemies. Punctured enemies receive %k bonus pierce damage from ANY pierce damage source for %k.

name: Gem of Skulls
description: Killing an enemy with a Sneak Attack or Merciless Attack has a %k chance to spawn a level %k companion skull.

name: Gem of Burning
description: Dealing fire damage applies burning for %k which deals %k per second. After a successful trigger, it has a cooldown of %k.

name: Gem of Fracturing
description: Killing an enemy with blunt damage has a  %k chance to create homing bone shards that deal %k blunt damage, with a chance of spawning up to 4 projectiles.

name: Gem of Retaliation
description: Blocking damage has a %k chance to add %k bonus blunt damage to the next attack within the next few seconds and increases the pushback.

name: Gem of Toxic Betrayal
description: Landing a backstab on an enemy applies poison for %k that deals %k poison damage per second.

name: Gem of Swiftness
description: After sprinting for a short time, attacks deal %k bonus cutting damage for %k. The duration refreshes every time damage is dealt.

name: Gem of Hopeful Embers
description: When the remaining time in the Shroud is below %k, defeated enemies drop time replenishing Orbs.

name: Gem of Storm's Eye
description: Hitting an enemy puts a mark on them for %k. Hitting a marked enemy sends a lightning bolt to another marked enemy, dealing %k damage. The attack can chain to more marked enemies. After lightning triggers, the effect has a %k cooldown before it can retrigger from the same enemy. After the cooldown, the mark is refreshed.

name: Gem of Lesser Necromancy
description: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Wretch at level %k. You can only have 4 active Wretches from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the oldest one. Hollow Wretches decay when out of combat for too long.

name: Gem of Agility
description:
After performing an evade action, the next hit deals %k additional cutting damage and replenishes 
%k stamina on the next hit.

name: Gem of Overpowering
description: Attacking a blocking enemy deals %k additional stamina damage and increased pushback.

name: Gem of Focused Light
description: Targeting an enemy for a few seconds while aiming or blocking puts a mark on the enemy. Attacking the marked enemy deals %k additional fire damage. The mark can stack up to 3 times by continued targeting, increasing the bonus damage by %k at 2 stacks and %k at 3 stacks.

name: Gem of Soul Reaping
description: Damaging an enemy puts a mark on them for %k. Marked enemies spawn a soul phial on death that can be destroyed to heal you and your allies for %k Health points in a 5m radius and also counts as an enemy kill for other effects.

name: Gem of Corruption
description: Hitting an enemy applies a mark that can stack up to 5 times. Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of mark has been added for %k or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals %k Shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0,5m and %k of the base damage to the explosion.

name: Gem of Battle Mania
description: While the Elixir buff is active, dealing damage activates the Satisfied Battle Mania buff, granting %k Health, %k Mana and %k Stamina regeneration for %k. Each additional hit refreshes the duration of that buff; however, once it runs out, the Unsatisfied Battle Mania debuff will suspend any Health, Stamina, and Mana regeneration for %k.

name: Gem of Cold Composure
description: Blocking or aiming for a short time grants %k physical and %k magical resistance, but slows the movement by %k. Getting hit or attacking while buffed creates an ice explosion that deals %k ice damage and slows enemies, after which the buff gets removed.

name: Gem of Meteoric Impact
description: Landing after gliding creates an explosion that deals %k fire damage and leaves behind a trail of fire that applies burning to enemies, dealing %k damage per second for %k. After the initial impact, attacks deal %k additional fire damage for %k.

name: Gem of Bloodlust
description: Grants a %k base chance to spawn a health orb when defeating an enemy. Collecting a health orb grants %k additional cutting damage to attacks and increases the chance for health orbs by %k for %k.

name: Gem of Currents
description: While Wet or Soaked, damaging enemies will apply Soaked to them for %k sec. Damaging soaked enemies has a chance of %k to deal %k bonus Shock Damage. Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30%% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

name: Gem of Aerobatics
description: Attacking while in the air spawns %k projectiles that home towards your target and deal %k piercing damage.

name: Gem of Greater Necromancy
description: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Reaper at level %k. You can only have 1 active Reaper from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the existing one. Reapers decay when out of combat for too long.

name: Gem of Lycanthropy
description: Defeating an enemy at night has a %k chance to spawn a Lunar Orb. Collecting a Lunar Orb grants %k Health and %k Mana aswell as a special food buff that grants %k max Health, %k max Mana, %k max Stamina and %k melee damage for %k.

name: Gem of Cleansing
description: Dealing damage removes the enemy's Shroud Damage Resistance for %k.

name: Gem of Destiny
description: Mark one random enemy within %km as Marked by Destiny for %k. Defeating the marked enemy spawns an orb that grants either %k health, %k mana, or %k stamina depending on which resource is most depleted.

name: Gem of Armoring
description: Killing an enemy spawns an orb at the enemy's location. Collecting the orb allows you to resist all damage for %k.

name: Gem of Hyperspecialization
description: After triggering the weapons Special Ability, any kill within %k will return %k Focus.

name: Village Oak
description:
A mix of umber and gray, exhibiting both wisdom and solidity.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

name: Windy Fields
description:
Grayish green hues combined with a dusty rose color.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

name: Polished Stone
description:
The light and dark facets of polished rock. Together, they remind of stone masonry, or more tragically, graveyard sculptures.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

name: Cloudy Brook
description:
An arrangement of warm grays and browns, reminiscent of a muddy brook lined by hazelnut bushes.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

name: Antique
description:
Softspoken, sandy browns, and bright ash colors give this palette a dusty, but distinguished look.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Flint
description:
A mix of flint and basalt, with a hint of faded lavender.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Icy Brook
description:
An arrangement of cool grays and blues, reminiscent of an icy brook on a cloudy day.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Rocky Shore
description:
The deep blue hue that takes center stage in this palette can be found beyond rocky beaches, or on rainy days by the cliff.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Blue Goblet
description:
A dance of cerulean and powder blue.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Silver Chalice
description:
The bright silver tone of this color palette decorated many of the realm's opulent chalices. It's known to pair well with the sanguine red of wine or the treacherous green glow of deceit and poison.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Mossy Stone
description:
The dark brown and green give the appearance of an overgrown garden or a mystical clearing.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Forgotten Library
description:
The warm brown and dusty green hues remind you of old leather-bound books with frayed bookmarks and copper clasps.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Deceit
description:
At first glance, the muted mauve shrouds the wearer in the mundane. Only a keen eye can spot the deceitful, spiteful green lurking underneath.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Verily Verdant
description:
Abundant like clover fields, yet mysterious like wild ivy scaling a wizard's tower. 

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Sediment
description:
The color of arid roads and sandy tombs.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Rust
description:
Colored like rusted metal, slate, and copper.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Madly Maroon
description:
The color of red wine, dried blood, and broken promises.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Harvest Festival
description:
A collection of bright oranges that exhibit a warm and inviting glow.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Liquid Light
description:
Like the morning sun, reflected in the still water of an ivory bowl.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Pinky Promise
description:
The chalky white and vibrant pink in this palette form a childlike innocence.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Dusk Amethyst
description:
A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Snowfall
description:
White like freshly fallen snow, somewhere on the edge of the world.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Mysterious Mauve
description:
A color palette that makes you feel like a scholar, wandering through wisteria-laden archways to take samples of the flora.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Pure Amethyst
description:
This electrifying purple palette has the same vibrancy as an untainted amethyst crystal.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Crimson Valor
description:
The rose-red accents on the ivory background add a romantic flair, painting the wearer to be a charming, valiant hero.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

name: Seafoam
description:
Refreshing like a salty gust of wind from the ocean.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Draped In Envy
description:
The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Emerald Forest
description:
Lush and lively like the Nomad Highlands flora before the drought.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Pastel Yearwake
description:
Life still blooms everywhere around.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Prowl
description:
The array of reds, oranges, and grays creates the ideal camouflage against the sundried mountains.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Cathedral
description:
A cool gray reminiscent of cathedral walls, eternal in its grace and silence.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Royal Decree
description:
None can deny your authority when you're dressed in sacred white and royal lavender.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Kingmaker
description:
Life isn't always black and white. Sometimes, power demands sacrifice.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Golden Leaf
description:
Green and brown with a hint of gold, like raining leaves on a slow day in fall.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Bright Resolve
description:
The brightness of the yellow tinge makes it appear almost fluorescent. While shining brighter than the sun, the thought of defeat becomes lost in the radiance.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
For a thief, the only light visible from within the shadows is that which is reflected on a glistening gold coin. 

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Green-Winged Orchid
description:
This color palette's combination of light green and vibrant purple takes inspiration from extinct orchids.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

name: Nightshade
description:
A dagger's point coated in poison is often more effective than diplomacy.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Lavender Dream
description:
Pitch-black like the night that swallows even the calmest of dreamers. The light lilac accents embody the color of lavender tea.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Lilac Insomnia
description:
The cold thrill of the night winds is far too electryfying to sleep. This color palette is bursting with a trance-like energy and tinged with madness.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: New Moon
description:
When the silence of the night begins to envelop the mountains, you best not step outside into the dark. Terror hides where the light does not reach.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

name: Waves Of Valor
description:
A vivid palette of bright blue, blazing red, and pure white — crisp, bold, and full of energy, like a banner snapping in the wind. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Holly and Berry
description:
This color palette is energetic and festive, evoking lush foliage and joyful celebrations.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Fell Fashion
description:
Look like a Fell foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Rust And Rose
description:
This color palette blends muted orange, soft mauve, and earthy brown into a palette that feels both weathered and graceful — like warmth preserved in fading light. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Pretty In Pink
description:
These vivid colors — deep cyan, bright magenta, and rich black — make a statement all on their own. With this palette, you won’t go unnoticed.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Ginger In A Jungle
description:
Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Gold In The Water
description:
Want to look like a gold nugget resting on the bottom of a lake? With this color palette, you embody just that — rich, vibrant blues with a hint of sparkling gold.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
Through the dark night until dawn drapes the sky in golden-yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too!

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Golden Ball
description:
This palette presents a multitude of yellow tones, vibrant as a polished golden ball or crown carried by a princess.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Aquamarine Dreams
description:
A luminous blend of crystal blues and soft turquoise hues captures the shimmering depths of clear waters. Calm yet vibrant, this palette radiates the freshness and clarity of aquamarine crystals, exuding a quiet elegance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Daylilies For Emily
description:
These warm oranges evoke the smell of daylilies, the warmth of a hearthfire, and the vision of sharing a sunrise with the one you love.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Heart's Desire
description:
Burning reds, crimson as a passionate kiss — or the blood of a weeping heart, pierced by a lance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Revelation By The Pond
description:
Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren't always as they seem — for both depths and dewdropped thicket hide fateful encounters.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Homage To Drak Slurp
description:
A bright green color palette, reminiscent of algae, shrubbery, and Drak cuisine.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Veil Of Blues
description:
The Veilwater Basin is rich in vibrant colors. The blue sky reflecting in the clear waters — and at night, the waters glow faintly, as if holding onto the memory of the day’s colors.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Shades Of Red
description:
Shadowy reds make this palette ideal for a moody night-time journey.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Frog In The Grass
description:
Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Twilight Bloom
description:
When darkness falls, the passionflowers begin to bloom. In the night, their petals can shift to a muted pink, almost purple, while their cores continue to glow brightly.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Ancient Greenery
description:
Cabbage, thyme, and moonstone — greens that run deep, blues that carry something ancient.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Bitter Harvest
description:
An unlikely trio — sulfur, thyme, and grandleaf cabbage creating something bold.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Dusk Garden
description:
Ancient and earthy, cut through with a breath of fresh thyme.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Light And Shadow
description:
Bold as midday sun, tempered by white and grounded in black.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Just Enough
description:
You prefer the clean look with just enough color sprinkled in for your unique style.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Sun & Shore
description:
The sand is pale and warm, the water deep and blue, the sun comes out and shines just for you. 

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Gilded Depths
description:
Dark as the deep end, a green so rich it swallows light. Balanced with a warm gold and bright turquoise.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Royal Temper
description:
This palette carries itself with quiet authority. It's regal without trying, and bold without apology.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Blooming Anyway
description:
Earthy, muddy, and rooted. But even in the most bleak areas, some flowers bloom and bring back color.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Gilded Contrast
description:
White and black in bold opposition, with just a thread of gold to hold it all together. Minimal, but deliberate.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Convergence
description:
One born from the depths below, one fallen from the stars above — two otherworldly forces that should never meet, yet here they are. Combined into something entirely their own. Beautiful in their contradiction.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Violet Grove
description:
The Flora of Cinder's Cradle: Fruits that ripen into every shade of violet imaginable. Dark as a bruise or soft as dusk. 

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: Crimson Ground
description:
Blood and mud — only weak humans bleed this much. Victory is ours! RAH!

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

name: A Distant Star
description:
Surrounded by black sand and basalt stone, the darkness closes in — but it never wins. Sometimes it's a distant star on a starry night, other times it's a friendly face. There is always something. There is always light.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

description: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.

name: Underwater Luminous Growth
description: An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.

name: Underwater Mud
description: Soft, water-soaked mud, hauled up from the bottom of a lake or silent stream.

name: Gold Coins
description: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.

name: Fine Sand
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Shell Limestone Road Block
description: This is a road material made from shell limestone, which is commonly found in Veilwater Basin.

name: Basalt
description: Dense, dark volcanic stone, harder than common Cinder Rock. Masons prize it for its durability and even texture.

name: Cinder's Cradle Dirt
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Cinder's Cradle Sand
description: Fine, dark sand found along volcanic shorelines.

name: Fertile Cinder's Cradle Dirt
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Cinder's Cradle Rubble
description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

name: Cinder Rock
description: Rough, ashen stone found in abundance across Cinder's Cradle.

name: Blackmire Dirt
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Blackmire Rubble
description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

name: Blackmire Stone
description: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

name: Fertile Blackmire Dirt
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Basalt Farm Soil
description: Enriched with basalt dust, this soil holds the particular nutrients that plants from Cinder's Cradle demand. Common ground won't do for them — this will.

name: Fertile Altered Dirt
description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

name: Ancient Road Block
description: A unique building block for roads. It creates paths with harmonious circle patterns.

name: Simple Fishing Rod
description: A basic fishing rod made out of the simplest ingredients. Don't pull too hard, or it might break. It also doesn't lay particularly well in the hand, so long fights are not possible with it.

name: Improved Fishing Rod
description: A stronger rod, which makes it easier to reel in a fish and you can also endure the fight longer.

name: Cursed Fishing Rod
description: A doomed fishing rod that is more likely to either catch valuables or junk. Well, one man's trash is another man's treasure!

name: Excellent Fishing Rod
description: A fine fishing rod that makes catching fish as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.

name: Lucky Fishing Rod
description: A lucky fishing rod that is quite strong and also more likely to catch treasures!

name: Grasshopper
description: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.

name: Frog
description:
A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fish bait. 

Especially helpful to catch epic fish from the Veilwater Basin.

name: Moth
description: Collected in the field for alchemical use. Also works as fishing bait, favored by uncommon fish.
acquisition_hint: Revelwood and Nomad Highlands, At Night

name: Fire Fly
description:
An animal, also blessed by the Flame, that spreads light in the dark.

Can be used as fishing bait, especially liked by common fish.

name: Pillbug
description: A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.

name: Scarab
description: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.

name: Maggots
description: Worms are good for catching all kinds of epic fish. Especially the ones from Cinder's Cradle.

name: Epic Fishing Bait I
description: Catch regular epic fish with ease thanks to this special bait.

name: Uncommon Fishing Bait
description: Any uncommon fish will want to take a bite of this bait.

name: Common Fishing Bait
description: An almost guaranteed catch for common fish!

name: Rare Fishing Bait
description: This special mix drives rare fish wild and makes it easy for you to catch them.

name: Epic Fishing Bait II
description: This bait tastes so good, so when a fish bites, it will definitely be an epic fish local to Cinder's Cradle.

name: Simple Fishing Bait
description: Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.
